name: Wait Then Fire
text: If none of the 10th Regiment of Foot move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.

name: Melee Defense 1
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot adds 1 to his defense dice.

name: Bayonet Attack 1
text: When rolling attack dice against an adjacent figure, a Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot adds 1 to his attack dice. A Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot can only use Bayonet Attack if he moved at least one space this turn.

name: Wait Then Fire
text: If none of the 4th Massachusetts Line move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.

name: Valiant Army Defense Bonus
text: If every Army Card you control has a valiant personality, each soldier in the 4th Massachusetts Line recieves 1 additional defense die.

name: SUPER LEAP
text: Instead of his normal move, Abomination may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Abomination's Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Abomination may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Abomination may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Abomination is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Abomination rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.

name: STOMP SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 1 Attack 3
All figures adjacent to Abomination are also affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Abomination cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses his Super Leap.

name: LEAF OF THE HOME TREE AURA
text: When any Elf you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Acolarh would receive enough wounds to be destroyed, you may roll 10 Ullar Valkyrie dice before removing the figure. If you roll at least 3 Ullar symbols, ignore any wounds that figure would have received. Acolarh’s Leaf of the Home Tree Aura does not affect Acolarh.

name: Ullar's Amulet
text: All friendly figures who follow Ullar and start their turn adjacent to Acolarh may move 2 additional spaces.

name: Admiral's Orders
text: After rolling for initiative, you may move any Order Markers from this card onto any of your Pirate or Captain Army Cards.

name: Boarding Party Special Attack
text: Range 5. Attack 2+ Special. You may attack up to 4 times with Boarding Party Special Attack. Roll one additional attack die when attacking a figure engaged with a Pirate or Captain you control. After each attack, if that was the first time you attacked the defending figure this turn, you may move one Pirate or Captain figure you control up to 4 spaces. You may not move the same figure more than once in a turn using Boarding Party Special Attack.

name: Ghost Walk
text: Agent Carr can move through all figures.

name: Sword of Reckoning 4
text: If Agent Carr is attacking an adjacent figure, add 4 dice to Agent Carr's attack.

name: Disengage
text: Agent Carr is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: CRIPPLING GLANCE 15
text: Before moving normally, you may choose a figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Agent Carr. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card.

name: SWORD OF RECKONING 4
text: Add 4 to Agent Carr's Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.

name: DISENGAGE
text: Agent Carr is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: OBFUSCATION MATRIX
text: SI-4X's space and all spaces within 1 of SI-4X are considered shadow spaces in addition to their other terrain types.

name: PHANTOM PROTOCOLS
text: Revna and Vydar figures you control that start their movement on a shadow space can move through all figures and do not take leaving engagement attacks during that movement.

name: SHADOW ASSASSIN
text: While SI-4X is attacking a Hero or Squad figure that is on a shadow tile, all skulls in the attack roll count for one additional skull.

name: Double Attack
text: When Agent Skahen attacks, she may attack one additional time.

name: COVER FIRE
text: After Agent Skahen attacks with a normal attack, if she inflicted one or more wounds, you may move one Tricky figure you control who follows Vydar and is within 8 clear sight spaces of Agent Skahen up to 4 spaces. You cannot use Cover Fire to move Agent Skahen.

name: Stealth Dodge
text: When Agent Skahen rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

name: Swirling Vortex
text: When an opponent's small or medium figure moves onto a space within 2 clear sight spaces of an Air Elemental you control, that figure must end its move there. Figures can never move through any figure affected by Swirling Vortex.

name: Air Mastery
text: Figures that have the Flying or Stealth Flying special power subtract 1 from their defense dice when attacked by an Air Elemental.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for an Air Elemental’s movement, ignore elevations. An Air Elemental may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Air Elemental starts to fly, if it is engaged it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Skyhook
text: After Air Marshall Zed Nesbitt finishes moving, if he used the Flying Special Power during this movement, you may choose any number of friendly Small or Medium Vorids that Nesbitt passed over this turn. Place those figures adjacent to Nesbitt. Figures moved with Skyhook never take leaving engagement attacks.

name: Crash Landing Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 5. Nesbitt can only use Crash Landing Special attack if he used the Flying Special Power this turn. All figures adjacent to Nesbitt are affected by Crash Landing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After using Crash Landing Special Attack, you must place one Wound Marker on this Army Card, and Nesbitt cannon move normally for the rest of the round.

name: GRENADE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 5. Attack 2. Explosion 1.\nThe Airborne Elite may only use Grenade Special Attack once per game. If they do, all attacking Airborne Elite must use Grenade Special Attack. If neither the attacking Airborne Elite nor the targeted figure are under an overhang, no line of sight is needed.

name: The Drop
text: Airborne Elite do not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of each round, before you place Order Markers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher you may place all 4 Airborne Elite figures on any empty spaces. You cannot place them adjacent to each other or other figures, or on a glyph.

name: OVEREXTEND
text: Once per round, after taking a turn with Alastair MacDirk, you may place a Wound Marker on Alastair and take another turn with him.

name: Turn Undead Special Attack
text: Range 4, Attack 4 Turn Undead Special Attack can be used only to attack Undead figures.

name: Protection From Evil Aura
text: All small or medium figures you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Ana Karithion add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against an attack from a figure who follows Utgar. Ana Karithon's Protection from Evil Aura does not affect Ana Karithon.

name: Healing Word
text: After revealing an Order Marker on a wounded small or medium Hero figure you control that is adjacent to Ana Karithon, and before using any other special powers on any Army Card or Treasure Glyph, you may first roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1 - 12 nothing happens. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove up to 2 wound markers from that Hero's Army Card.

name: UNLEASHED FURY
text: At the start of Anubian Wolves’ turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, choose an Anubian Wolf you control and destroy it. If you roll any other result, increase the Attack Value of this card until the end of the Anubian Wolves’ turn, as follows. If you roll 2–6, add 1 to its Attack Value. If you roll a 12–15, add 3 to its Attack Value. If you roll a 16–19, add 4 to its Attack Value. If you roll a 20, add 8 to its Attack Value.

name: Staff of Lerkintin
text: When defending with Arkmer, add as many defense dice as the number of Elves you control adjacent to Arkmer.

name: Engagement Strike 13
text: If an opponent's small or medium figure moves, adjacent to Arkmer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the opponent's figure receives one wound. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with Arkmer.

name: Ullar Warlord Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Armoc Vipers, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control who follows Ullar.

name: Slither
text: Armoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

name: Beast Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Arrow Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Beast you control.

name: Disengage
text: Arrow Gruts are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: WAIT THEN FIRE
text: When attacking with Ashigaru Harquebus, if no Ashigaru Harquebus figures moved this turn, add 1 to their Attack Value this turn.

name: ENCIRCLE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 1. Attack 6.\nInstead of making normal attacks with any Ashigaru Yari, if 3 Ashigaru Yari that you activated this turn are adjacent to the same enemy figure, the Ashigaru Yari that is on the lowest level of the 3 may attack that enemy figure with Encircle Special Attack.

name: FOLLOW THE PROFIT
text: Before taking a turn with Associates of Volarak, you may first take a turn with a Profiteer Hero you control. If you do and that Profiteer attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object during that turn, Associates of Volarak add 1 to their Attack Value this Player Turn.

name: PEPPERBOX PISTOL SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 5. Attack 2.\nAn Associate of Volarak may attack with Pepperbox Pistol Special Attack after making a normal attack.

name: Kyrie Leadership
text: All Kyrie you control, except Atlaga, move one additional space.

name: Ullar's Bolt of the Witherwood
text: After moving and before attacking with Atlaga, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Atlaga. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1 - 15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure is destroyed. Atlaga may attempt to use this power only once per game.

name: Frenzy
text: After you take a turn with the Aubrien Archers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 16 or higher, you may take another turn with the Aubrien Archers.

name: INTELLIGENCE CHIEF
text: The first time each round you reveal a numbered Order Maker on this Army Card, instead of taking a turn with Baroness you may take a turn with up to 2 different COBRA or Agent Heroes you control. Baroness can be one of those Heroes.

name: FALSE ORDERS 16
text: At the end of Baroness' turn, you may choose an enemy figure within 6 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may look at an Order Marker on that figure's Army Card. You may then move that Order Marker to the Army Card of another of that player's figures which is within 6 clear sight spaces of Baroness.

name: DISENGAGE
text: Baroness never takes leaving engagement attacks.

name: STRAFE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Line 5. Attack 3.\nFriendly figures are not affected by Strafe Special Attack.

name: BATTLE READY
text: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Battle Copter. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.

name: RIGOROUS TRAINING
text: Beachhead adds 1 automatic skull to his attack rolls and 1 automatic shield to his defense rolls.

name: SWIM
text: Beachhead does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space.

name: Fledgling Acid Breath
text: Instead of attacking with a Black Wyrmling, you may choose one small or medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces of it. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1 - 10, nothing happens. If you roll an 11 - 15, the chosen figure recieves 1 wound. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds.

name: Wyrmling Bonding
text: After revealing an order marker on a Black Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that Black Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.

name: Orc Champion Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Blade Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Orc Champion you control.

name: Disengage
text: Blade Gruts are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Gladiatron Movement Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Blastatrons, you may move 4 Gladiatrons you control up to 5 spaces each.

name: HOMING DEVICE
text: When attacking a non-adjacent figure, add 1 to that Blastatron's Attack Value for every Vydar Soulborg you control adjacent to the defending figure.

name: QUICKDRAW 7
text: When "Blink" Dawson is chosen as a target for a normal attack from an enemy figure within 7 clear sight spaces that is not adjacent, you may immediately roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or higher, the attacking figure takes 1 wound and the attack immediately ends.

name: Fledgling Lightning Breath Special Attack
text: Range: 4+ Special, Attack: 2 Choose a figure to attack. You may choose one other figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Fledgling Lightning Breath Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Fledgling Lightning Breath Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.

name: Wyrmling Bonding
text: After revealing an order marker on a Blue Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that Blue Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.

name: Intimidate
text: Small and Medium figures within 3 clear sight spaces of Bok-Bur-Na reduce their Defense Value by 1 when attacked by a Captain or Pirate you control.

name: Swashbuckler
text: After attacking with Bok-Bur-Na, you may attack an adjacent figure 1 additional time. Bok-Bur-Na's Attack Value is increased by 2 for the second attack.

name: Utgar's Cutlass 14
text: When Bok-Bur-Na destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 14 or higher, remove one Wound Marker from Bok-Bur-Na. Bok-Bur-Na cannot use Utgar's Cutlass on destructible objects.

name: Sky Watcher
text: If Brandis Skyhunter is attacking a non-adjacent figure that has the Flying or Stealth Flying special power, add 2 dice to Brandis Skyhunter's attack.

name: ARCHER’S GLORY
text: After taking a turn with Brandis Skyhunter, if he destroyed an opponent’s non-adjacent Unique Hero, you may take another turn with Brandis.

name: Tracking
text: While moving, Brave Arrow may add 2 to his move number. If he does, he cannot attack this turn.

name: Scout Melee Attack Enhancement
text: All friendly scouts adjacent to Brave Arrow receive an additional attack die when attacking a figure adjacent to them.

name: Concealment 10
text: If Brave Arrow is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and Brave Arrow. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 10 or higher, ignore any wounds Brave Arrow just received.

name: Poisonous Acid Breath
text: Instead of attacking, you may choose up to 3 different small or medium figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Braxas. One at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each chosen figure. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll an 8 or higher, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero. (since this is not an attack, engagement rules do not apply)

name: Carry
text: Before moving Brunak, choose an unengaged friendly small or medium figure adjacent to Brunak. After you move Brunak, place the chosen figure adjacent to Brunak.

name: Blood Hungry Special Attack
text: Range 1 Attack 4 If Brunak's Blood Hungry Special Attack destroys a figure, Brunak may attack again with his Blood Hungry Special Attack. Brunak may continue attacking with his Blood Hungry Special Attack until he does not destroy a figure.

name: Lava Resistant
text: Brunak never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage and he does not have to stop in molten lava spaces.

name: ACID SACS 9
text: If a Bursting Hive Soldier receives enough wounds to be destroyed by a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, before destroying that Soldier, roll the 20-sided die once for each adjacent figure that is not a Skordyre. If you roll a 9 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.

name: A COWARD'S REWARD
text: A Bursting Hive Soldier rolls 1 additional die when making a leaving engagement attack.

name: PICK UP THE TRAIL
text: After a Player Turn in which 1 or more Unique Heroes you control were destroyed, you may move all Order Markers on those Heroes' Army Cards to this Army Card. Then, if any of the destroyed Heroes was a Lawman, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take a turn with Cainak, Private Eye.

name: SHIELD THROW SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 5. Attack 4.
When Captain America attacks with his Shield Throw Special Attack, he may attack 2 additional times. He cannot attack the same figure more than once.

name: TACTICIAN
text: All friendly figures adjacent to Captain America add 1 extra die to their attack, and 1 extra die to their defense.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.

name: Human Gladiator Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with the Capuan Gladiators, you may first take a turn with any Human Gladiator Hero you control.

name: Initiative Advantage
text: If all of your Order Markers are on Gladiator Army Cards, you may add 1 to your initiative roll for every Order Marker on the Capuan Gladiators' Army Card, up to a maximum of +3 for Initiative Advantage.

name: GUILD BOSS BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with Chain Gruts, you may first take a turn with a Champion you control who is an Orc or who follows Volarak.

name: CHAIN AXES
text: After rolling attack dice, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll 1 die that did not roll a skull.

name: STRONG-ARM
text: Figures engaged with 1 or more Chain Gruts cannot make leaving engagement attacks against figures that are not Chain Gruts.

name: RENEW 12
text: If Chana the Zenithwing is within 5 clear sight spaces of a Wizard that you control, instead of attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, you may remove one Wound Marker from a friendly Wizard or Beast adjacent to Chana.

name: FIRE STRIKE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 6. Attack 2 + Special. When Chardris attacks with Fire Strike Special Attack, add 1 to Chardris’ attack dice for every additional Elf Wizard you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Chardris, up to a maximum of +3 dice.

name: IMPROVED COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Charos successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: CUTLASSSS OF COBRA
text: COBRA Commander adds 1 automatic skull when attacking adjacent figures.

name: I'LL GET YOU NEXT TIME
text: After COBRA Commander receives 1 or more wounds from a normal attack and is not destroyed, you may move COBRA Commander up to 2 spaces. He may not end this movement adjacent to an enemy figure. While moving with I'll Get You Next Time, COBRA Commander does not take leaving engagement attacks.

name: AIR-TO-GROUND MISSILE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 4. Explosion 1. Attack 3.

name: BATTLE READY
text: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on COBRA Flight Pod. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.

name: VILLAINOUS BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with COBRA Troopers, you may first take a turn with a Warlord or Profiteer Hero you control.

name: COILS OF COBRA
text: COBRA Troopers add 1 to their Attack Value for each adjacent Unique Cobra figure you control.

name: Knight and Sentinel Enhancement
text: All friendly Knights and Sentinels adjacent to Concan roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

name: MIGHT OF BLEAKEWOODE
text: Other Jandar figures you control within 5 clear sight spaces of Concan the Kyrie Warrior add 1 to their Attack Value if there is a revealed Order Marker on an Utgar Army Card in your Army.

name: VIGILANCE OF NASTRALUND
text: Utgar figures you control within 5 clear sight spaces of Concan add 1 to their Defense Value if there is a revealed Order Marker on a Jandar Army Card in your Army.

name: First Assault 2
text: When Cornelius Breech, the Derelict Prince attacks, if the defending figure was not adjacent to him at the start of this turn, Cornelius adds 2 to his Attack Value during this attack.

name: Mutiny
text: After a Unique Captain you control receives a wound or is destroyed, any or all Pirate Squads you control that chose that Captain for the Captain's Way Special Power may choose Cornelius to be their chosen Captain for the rest of the game. If any Squads do, remove all Wound Markers from Cornelius Breech.

name: EYES IN THE SKY
text: For special powers that are not attacks on the Army Cards of Unique Undead and Wizard Heroes you control, you may treat figures within clear sight of Corvynn as within clear sight of the Undead or Wizard Hero. When doing so, count range from Corvynn instead of the Undead or Wizard Hero.

name: CLUSTER CANNON SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 6. Attack 2.\nThis figure may attack up to 4 times with Cluster Cannon Special Attack.

name: G.I. JOE IS THERE
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Courtney “Cover Girl” Krieger, you may take a turn with a Unique G.I. JOE or Soldier Hero you control.

name: ARMORED SUPPORT
text: After using the Battle Ready Special Power on a Hero you control and taking a turn with that Hero, you may take a turn with this Hero.

name: TANK MOVEMENT
text: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.

name: ONE TWIN FEELS WHAT THE OTHER TWIN FEELS
text: The Crimson Twins share a Life Pool. Put all Wound Markers either Twin receives on this Army Card. Both Twins are destroyed when this Army Card has Wound Markers equal to its Life Value. This special power cannot be negated.

name: BANKROLL
text: At the start of the game, you may choose one Unique Hero in your Army. For this game, that figure's Affiliation is COBRA, regardless of what it says on the figure's Army Card.

name: BUSINESS OPERATIONS
text: After a Crimson Twin attacks with a normal attack, you may move another unengaged COBRA figure you control up to 2 spaces.

name: HIRE CREW
text: At the start of the game, you may choose a Unique Squad in your Army. For this game the chosen Squad's class becomes Pirate, replacing the class listed on its Army Card.

name: PIRATE COMMANDER
text: While there is an Order Marker on Crimson Widow, all Pirates you control increase their Attack Value by 1 when attacking adjacent figures.

name: MIDNIGHT RAID
text: Before taking a turn with Crimson Widow, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to choose up to two Pirates you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Crimson Widow. You may move the chosen Pirates up to 3 spaces each.

name: ONE SHIELD DEFENSE
text: When comparing Crixus’s shield results to an attacker’s skull results, if there are more skull results then shield results and at least one shield was rolled, Crixus blocks all skulls except for 1

name: ARROW OF LOVE 16
text: Start the game with 2 pink Adoration Markers on this Army Card. After moving and before attacking, you may choose an enemy Unique Hero within 5 clear sight spaces and a Unique Hero you control other than Cupid within 3 clear sight spaces of the first figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, place an Adoration Marker on each Hero's Army Card, remove all Order Markers on the enemy Hero, and take control of the enemy Hero.

name: LOVESICKNESS
text: After Cupid or a figure with one of your Adoration Markers is destroyed, remove all Order Markers from the controlled Hero. Then, at the end of the round, return it to its original owner and return both Adoration Markers to this Army Card.

name: Life Drain
text: Each time Cyprien Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Cyprien Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.

name: Chilling Touch
text: After moving and before attacking, Cyprien Esenwein may attempt a Chilling Touch. To do this, choose a figure adjacent to Cyprien Esenwein and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-12, nothing happens. If you roll 13-15, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If you roll 16-17, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds. If you roll 18-19, the chosen figure receives 3 wounds. If you roll a 20 or higher, the chosen figure receives 6 wounds.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for Cyprien Esenwein’s movement, ignore elevations. Cyprien Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Cyprien Esenwein starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Sneak Attack 2
text: If Darrak Ambershard is attacking an opponent's figure adjacent to at least one other figure you control, add 2 dice to Darrak Ambershard's attack.

name: Disarm Traps
text: When you roll the 20-sided die for a treasure glyph trap with Darrak Ambershard, you may add 4 to your die roll.

name: Hide in Darkness
text: If Darrak Ambershard is attacked with a normal attack and at least one skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If Darrak Ambershard is on a Dungeon space, add three to your die roll. If he is on a Shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1-15, roll defence dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

name: Ullar Enhanced Rifle Special Attack
text: Range 10. Attack 1. Choose a small or medium figure to attack. The chosen figure cannot roll defense dice when attacked by Deadeye Dan's Ullar Enhanced Rifle Special Attack. Deadeye Dan may not use this special attack if he moved this turn.

name: Sharpshooter
text: Instead of attacking, you may choose any non-adjacent figure within 10 clear sight spaces of Deadeye Dan. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or 20, the chosen figure is destroyed. If you roll a 1-18, you missed. Deadeye Dan may not use this special power if he moved this turn.

name: Taskmaster Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with the Death Chasers of Thesk, you may first take a turn with any large wild Hero you control.

name: Orc Battle Rush
text: At the start of the first round of a game, after all order markers have been placed, you may move all Death Chasers of Thesk you control up to 5 spaces each. They must end their Orc Battle Rush movement on an empty space.

name: Soul Weapons
text: Figures attacked by a Death Knight of Valkrill subtract two from their defense dice. Destructible Objects are not affected by Soul Weapons.

name: Unholy Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with the Death Knights of Valkrill, you may first take a turn with any small, medium or large relentless Hero you control.

name: SCATTER
text: After a Deathreaver you control is attacked by an opponent's figure with a normal attack, you may move any 2 Deathreavers you control up to 4 spaces each.

name: Disengage
text: Deathreavers are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Deathreavers may double their Height.

name: Maul
text: When rolling attack dice against a small or medium figure, if a Deathstalker rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure receives a wound for every skull, and cannot roll any defense dice.

name: ANNIHILATION BEAM SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Line 10. Attack 1 + Special.\nAfter rolling the attack die, if it rolled a skull, add an additional die to the attack. If that die also rolls a skull, add an additional die. Keep adding dice to the attack until you do not roll a skull. Then add 1 automatic skull to the result.

name: PLATING OPTIMIZATION
text: Unique Utgar Soulborgs you control ignore all wounds from special powers that are not special attacks.

name: Self-Destruct
text: After moving and instead of attacking, Deathwalker may choose to self-destruct. Roll the 20-sided die to determine if any other figures are wounded. If you roll a 1-3, all adjacent figures are safe. If you roll a 4-15, each adjacent figure receives 2 wounds. If you roll a 16-19 each adjacent figure receives 4 wounds. If you roll a 20, each adjacent figure receives 8 wounds. After using this power, Deathwalker is always destroyed.

name: Stealth Dodge
text: When Deathwalker 7000 rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

name: Rapid Fire Special Attack
text: Range 7 Attack 3 If Deathwalker's Rapid Fire Special Attack inflicts a wound, he may attack again with his Rapid Fire Special Attack. Deathwalker may continue attacking with his Rapid Fire Special Attack until he does not inflict a wound.

name: Explosion Special Attack
text: Range 7. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Explosion Special Attack. Deathwalker only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Deathwalker can be affected by his own Explosion Special Attack.

name: RANGE ENHANCEMENT
text: Soulborg Guards you control with a Range Value of 4 or more that are adjacent to Deathwalker 9000 add 2 to their Range Value.

name: Underground Movement
text: Instead of moving normally with the Decker the Burrowbreaker, you may place him onto an empty non-water space within 4 spaces of Decker that is no higher than 6 levels above or 3 levels below Decker's level. If Decker is engaged when he starts his Underground Movement, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Drill-Drive Special Attack
text: Range Special. Attack 4. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Decker, you may move him up to 5 spaces in a straight line. When moving with Drill-Drive Special Attack, Decker may pass through figures and does not take leaving engagement attacks from figures he passed through. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through that turn. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Defending figures never have height advantage against Drill-Drive Special Attack.

name: Poison Weapons
text: Each time a Deepwyrm Drow attacks a small, medium, or large Hero with a normal attack or a leaving engagement attack and inflicts at least 1 wound, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-11, nothing happens. If you roll a 12 or higher, add 1 additional wound to the defending figure.

name: Hide in Darkness
text: If a Deepwyrm Drow is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Deepwyrm Drow is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. If it is on a shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1-15, roll defence dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

name: ORBITAL DEPLOYMENT 3
text: Figures with the Orbital Deployment Special Power do not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of a round, before placing Order Markers, you may place 1 Deflectatron that has not entered the battlefield on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of a friendly figure. You cannot use more than one Orbital Deployment Special Power each round.

name: PASSIVE
text: A Deflectatron never makes leaving engagement attacks.

name: MAGNETIC DEFLECTOR FIELD
text: Figures adjacent to one or more Deflectatrons cannot determine clear sight to any figures. When a figure adjacent to one or more of your Deflectatrons defends against an attack from a non-adjacent figure, change 1 die result that was not a shield to a shield, if possible. Magnetic Deflector Field is negated while adjacent to another figure with the Magnetic Deflector Field Special Power.

name: GUNRUNNER
text: At the start of the game, you may place up to 2 different Tech Glyphs power-side up onto the Army Cards of up to 2 different Unique Heroes in your Army.

name: BERYLLIUM STEEL MASK
text: Destro adds 1 automatic shield to his defense rolls against attacks from non-adjacent figures.

name: PERSONAL ARSENAL
text: Once per turn, after making a normal attack, Destro may reduce his Attack Value by 2 and make an additional normal attack.

name: MIND EXCHANGE 17
text: After taking a turn with Doctor Doom, you may choose any Unique Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Doctor Doom. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take temporary control of that hero and immediately take a turn with the chosen Hero. At the end of that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to the player who controlled the Hero before the Mind Exchange. All Order Markers that were on the chosen Hero's card will stay on the card.

name: FLYING
text: When counting spaces for Doctor Doom's movement, ignore elevations. Doctor Doom may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Doctor Doom starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: A LITTLE SUGGESTION
text: At the start of Doctor Mindbender's turn, you may move all friendly figures adjacent to Doctor Mindbender up to 3 spaces.

name: BEND MIND 13
text: At the end of Doctor Mindbender's turn, you may choose an enemy Unique figure within 3 spaces of Doctor Mindbender and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, after this turn you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Doctor Mindbender. If you do, take temporary control of the enemy Army Card and take a turn with it. After the turn, control returns to the Army Card's previous owner.

name: ALWAYS PREPARED
text: After rolling for initiative, if there are no Common cards in your army, you may move one single-spaced figure from each other card in your army up to 3 spaces. Figures moved this way must end their movement within 3 clear sight spaces of Don Ramón.

name: RALLY THE CREW
text: Start the game with 3 orange Rejuvenation Markers on this card. Once per round, after Don Ramón attacks an opponent's figure, you may remove up to 3 Rejuvenation Markers from this card to choose the same number of different single-spaced figures (other than Don Ramón) within 3 clear sight spaces of Don Ramon. Remove 1 wound marker from each chosen figure.

name: Charge!!!
text: If Dorim the Bulkhead Brawler attacks an opponent's figure during his turn, the Move Value of all of your Army Cards is increased by 1 until the next time you reveal an Order Marker.

name: Chain Axe
text: After rolling attack dice, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll one die that did not roll a skull.

name: PROTOTYPE INJECTION
text: Begin the game with 3 cyan Cyaline Markers on this Army Card. Once per Player Turn, before Dr. Harlan Eisen or another Eisenek, Vorid, or Scientist figure you control within 5 clear sight spaces moves normally or defends, you may remove a Cyaline Marker from this card to add 1 to the Move, Attack, and Defense Values of that figure's Army Card until the end of that Player Turn.

name: MORE MACHINE THAN VORID
text: Once per game, after removing a Cyaline Marker from this Army Card, you may remove all Wound Markers from this Army Card and return any removed Cyaline Markers to this Army Card. For the remainder of the game add 1 to Dr. Eisen's Attack Value and subtract 1 from his Defense Value.

name: GRAVEROBBER
text: After an enemy figure is destroyed within 5 clear sight spaces of Dr. Torvik Morinstein or another friendly Scientist or Wizard, you may place a chartreuse Parts Marker onto this Army Card, to a maximum of 3.

name: IT'S ALIVE!
text: Once per game, at the end Dr. Torvik Morinstein's turn, if Morinstein's Masterpiece is in your Army and there are 3 Parts Markers on this Army Card, you may remove them to place your Morinstein's Masterpiece onto the battlefield adjacent to Dr. Morinstein.

name: CHANNEL LIGHTNING SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 4 + Special. Attack 2.\nChoose a figure to attack. You may also choose a second figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure and a third figure within 2 clear sight spaces of the second figure to be affected by Channel Lightning Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

name: SCHEMES FROM SPACE
text: While Dr. Valentina Lockhart is on the battlefield, you may add 2 to your 20-sided die rolls for special powers of Unique Revna and Vydar figures in your Army.

name: COORDINATED DEPLOYMENT 3
text: At the start of the game, you may choose up to 2 Scout or Scientist figures from your Army and place them on this Army Card. These figures and Dr. Lockhart do not start the game on the battlefield. Once per game, before placing Order Markers, you may place Dr. Lockhart on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of a friendly figure. Then place any figures chosen by Coordinated Deployment on empty spaces adjacent to her, if possible.

name: ORBITAL STRIKE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 6. Attack 2 + Special. Explosion 2.\nAdd 2 skulls to the attack roll against the targeted figure. Add 1 skull against figures within 1 space of the targeted figure. Defending figures never have height advantage against this attack. Orbital Strike Special Attack can be used only once per game and cannot be used in the same round as Coordinated Deployment.

name: THE CAPTAIN’S WAY
text: At the start of the game, choose one Unique Captain in your Army to be the Dreadnoughts of Caraway Cavern's Captain for this game. Dreadnoughts roll one additional defense die against attacks from non-adjacent figures when their chosen Captain is within 4 clear sight spaces.

name: CAPTAIN’S ORDERS
text: Before taking a turn with the Dreadnoughts of Caraway Cavern, you may first take a turn with their chosen Captain or a Pirate Hero you control.

name: MORTAL BLOW
text: After attacking an opponent's figure, roll 1 attack die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, inflict 1 wound on that figure.

name: Chain Grab
text: After moving and before attacking with a Drow Chainfighter, you may choose one opponent's small or medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose base is no more than 6 levels above that Drow Chainfighter's height or 6 levels below that Drow Chainfighter's base. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to that Drow Chainfighter. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Chain Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Hide in Darkness
text: If a Drow Chainfighter is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Drow Chainfighter is on a dungeon space add 3 to your die roll, if he is on a shadow space add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1 - 15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

name: YO, JOE!
text: The first time each round you reveal a numbered Order Maker on this Army Card, instead of taking a turn with Duke you may take a turn with up to 2 G.I. JOE or Soldier Heroes you control. Duke can be one of those Heroes.

name: LEAD BY EXAMPLE
text: While Duke has a revealed Order Marker on his Army Card, other G.I. JOE and Soldier figures you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Duke add 1 to their Attack Value.

name: Road Strength
text: Add 1 to Dumutef Guard's attack and defense while on a road space.

name: Devourer Attack Enhancement
text: All friendly Devourers adjacent to a Dumutef Guard receive an additional attack die.

name: Crippling Gaze 15
text: Before moving, you may choose a figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Dünd. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher remove all order markers on the chosen figure's army card (or cards if your opponent has more than one common card for that figure).

name: SPECIES SPLICER
text: At the start of the game, you may choose 1 Species from another non-Soulborg Army Card in your Army. Until Durnipia is destroyed, she gains that Species.

name: BLOODSTITCHER 15
text: Once per turn, before or after moving normally, Durnipia may choose 1 adjacent non-Soulborg figure and remove 1 or 2 Wound Markers from it. If she does, she takes an equal number of wounds. If she was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die for each Wound Marker on her Army Card. For each roll of 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from Durnipia.

name: I'LL DO IT MYSELF
text: Once per round, before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on an Army Card in your Army, you may move that Order Marker to Durnipia and reveal it.

name: Glacier Traverse
text: If a Dzu-Teh is adjacent to a Glacier Mountain, the Dzu-Teh may Glacier Traverse instead of moving normally. You may do this with any or all Dzu-Teh you control each turn. To Glacier Traverse, move to any unoccupied space adjacent to that Glacier Mountain.

name: Glacier Camouflage
text: If a Dzu-Teh is adjacent to a Glacier Mountain, opponents' figures must be adjacent to that Dzu-Teh to attack it with a normal attack.

name: Snow and Ice Enhanced Movement
text: Slippery Ice and Heavy Snow only count as 1 space when moving.

name: Earth Slam Special Attack
text: Range 1 Attack 3 Any non-flying figures adjacent to this Earth Elemental are affected by Earth Slam Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately.

name: Underground Movement
text: Instead of moving normally with an Earth Elemental, you may immediately place it on any empty non-water space that is within 4 spaces of that Earth Elemental and is no higher than 1 level above that Earth Elemental's height or 3 levels below that Earth Elemental's base. If an Earth Elemental is engaged when it starts its Underground Movement, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: MOBILE GUNNER SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 5. Attack 4.\nEel & F'fuoh may attack with Mobile Gunner Special Attack after attacking normally. You may target and attack non-adjacent figures with Mobile Gunner Special Attack, even while engaged.

name: OUT OF CONTROL
text: If Eel & F'fuoh have 4 or more wounds at the start of their turn, they cannot use Mobile Gunner Special Attack and must attack all adjacent figures, even ones they are not engaged with.

name: SWIM
text: Eel & F'fuoh do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.

name: Overextend Attack
text: After taking a turn with Eldgrim, you may place a wound marker on Eldgrim and take another turn with him. You may only use this power once per round.

name: Warrior's Swiftness Spirit
text: When Eldgrim is destroyed, you may place this figure on any unique Army Card. Eldgrim's Spirit adds 1 to the move number on that card.

name: Slither
text: Elite Onyx Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

name: Frenzy
text: After you take a turn with the Elite Onyx Vipers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher you may take another turn with the Elite Onyx Vipers.

name: Evasive 8
text: When an Elite Onyx Viper rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, add 8 defense dice to the defending Viper.

name: BLADE DANCE
text: Unique Ullar Kyrie you control roll 1 additional die when attacking a figure engaged with 1 or more of your Elites of Ullar.

name: ULLAR'S PACT
text: If an Elite of Ullar receives a wound from a normal attack by an enemy figure, after that attack you may move 1 unengaged Kyrie figure you control who follows Ullar up to 4 spaces, even if all of your Elites of Ullar are destroyed.

name: Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack
text: Range 1+ Special Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to two other figures within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. You can only use Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack if Eltahale was not adjacent to the targeted figure at the start of this turn. You cannot use Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack if you used Thunder Step this turn.

name: Thunder Step
text: Instead of moving Eltahale normally, you may choose an opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Eltahale. Place Eltahale on any empty space adjacent to the chosen figure. For the duration of Eltahale's turn, add 1 to her Attack value. At the end of her turn, roll 1 attack die. If a skull is rolled, place 1 wound marker on Eltahale's Army Card. If Eltahale is engaged when she starts Thunder Step, she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Elven Summoning Spell
text: After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add the number of Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon to your die roll. If you roll 1-4, nothing happens. If you roll 5-11, you may place 1 Elf you control adjacent to Emirroon. If you roll 12-17, you may place up to 2 Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon. If you roll 18-20, you may place up to 3 Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon. If the summoned Elves are engaged, they will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Emirroon cannot summon an Elf that he is already adjacent to.

name: Gift of the Empress Aura
text: When you roll defense dice for any Kyrie that you control who follows Einar and is within 5 clear sight spaces of Empress Kiova, you may re-roll all defense dice that did not show shields. Gift of the Empress Aura can be used only once for each defense roll. Empress Kiova's Gift of the Empress Aura does not affect Empress Kiova.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for Empress Kiova's movement, ignore elevations. Empress Kiova may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Empress Kiova starts to fly, if she is engaged she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Fire Blast Special Attack
text: Range 5, Attack Special. Each time you attack with Erevan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack, you may choose to roll 2, 3, or 4 attack dice. If a skull is rolled on every die, you may attack again with Erevan Sunshadow' Fire Blast Special Attack. You may continue attacking with Erevan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack until you do not roll a skull on every die.

name: Fey Step
text: Once per game Erevan Sunshadow may use Fey Step. Before moving normally with Erevan Sunshadow, you may place him on any empty space within 5 spaces of his current location. If Erevan Sunshadow is engaged when he uses Fey Step, he will not take any engagement attacks.

name: VENOM RAY SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 5. Attack 3.
If Venom Ray Special Attack would inflict at least 1 wound, roll the 20-sided die for Venom Damage.
- If you roll a 10–19, add 1 to the number of wounds inflicted and roll again for Venom Damage.
- If you roll a 20, destroy the defending figure.

name: Lolth's Judgment Aura
text: All Arachnid figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Estivara roll 1 additional attack die when attacking normally.

name: Cloud of Darkness
text: After taking a turn with Estivara, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, while she remains on that space, Estivara has no visible Hit Zone until the next time you reveal an order marker.

name: Double Assault
text: When Evar Scarcarver attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time.

name: Frost Rage
text: When revealing a numbered order marker on Evar Scarcarver's Army Card, you may also reveal an "X" order marker that is on Evar Scarcarver's Army Card to activate Frost Rage for the duration of the round. While Frost Rage is active, add 1 to Evar Scarcarver's Attack and Defense values for each wound marker on his Army Card.

name: Command Familiar
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Ewashia, Master of Tides, before taking Ewashia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

name: Twister Special Attack
text: Range 5. Attack 4. Ewashia may use Twister Special Attack if she is within 1 space of a water tile. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to 2 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. All figures on those spaces are affected by Twister Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Ewashia is not affected by Twister Special Attack.

name: Aegis of the River
text: Ewashia does not have tostop her movement when entering a water space. Add 1 to Ewashia's Defense Value while she is on a water space.

name: Create Water
text: Ewashia starts each game with 3 water tiles on this Army Card. At the end of Ewashia's turn, you may place a water tile from this Army Card on Ewashia's space or within 1 space of Ewashia, if that water tile fits normally onto that space.

name: Black Powder Pistols
text: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to the Exiles of the Sundered Sea's Range number for the rest of this turn. You may only use this power once during a round.

name: Stealthy 13
text: If an Exile of the Sundered Sea you control is attacked by an opponent's figure that is not adjacent and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-12, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 13 or higher, that Exile takes no damage and may immediately move up to 3 spaces.

name: Disengage
text: Exiles of the Sundered Sea are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Hydra Heads
text: When this Fen Hydra attacks, it may attack up to 4 times. Reduce the number of times this Fen Hydra can attack by 1 for each wound marker on this Army Card.

name: Reach
text: If an opponent's figure is within 2 spaces of this Fen Hydra, and its base is no more than 3 levels above this Fen Hydra's height or 3 levels below this Fen Hyda's base, this Fen Hydra may add 1 to its Range when attacking that figure.

name: Slither
text: The Fen Hydra does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces.

name: Blood Frenzy
text: When attacking with this Feral Troll, it receives 1 additional attack die for each Wound Marker on the defending figure's Army Card, for a maximum of 3 additional attack dice for Blood Frenzy.

name: Regenerate
text: After taking a turn with this Feral Troll, remove 1 Wound Marker from this Feral Troll's army card.

name: Parasite
text: For the entire game, if one of your Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card at the end of the round, you must roll the 20-sided die for that Hero. If you roll a 17 or higher, destroy that Hero. If a Festering Honor Guard isd on a Unique Hero's Army Card when that Hero is destroyed by this Special Power, or by a normal attack, Special Attack, or leaving engagement attack, place that Festering Honor Guard on a space that Hero occupied, if possible.

name: Motherless Rage
text: If Queen Maladrix The Conqueror is in your Army, when she is detroyed, you may move any unrevealed Order Markers from her Army Card to this Army Card. Festering Honor Guards add 1 to their Attack Value if Queen Maladrix is in your Army and is destroyed.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Festering Honor Guard may double their height

name: Black Powder Pistol
text: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to Bonny's Range Value for the rest of the turn. You may only use this Special Power once during a round.

name: Master of Disguise 13
text: The first time each turn that Fia Bonny is targeted by a Squad figure with a normal or special attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, Bonny cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attack this turn.

name: Disengage
text: Fia Bonny is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Attack Aura 1
text: All friendly figures adjacent to Finn with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.

name: Warrior's Attack Spirit 1
text: When Finn is destroyed, place this figure on any Unique Army Card. Finn's Spirit adds 1 to the normal attack number on that card.

name: Lava Resistant
text: A Fire Elemental never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

name: Searing Intensity
text: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to at least one Fire Elemental you control. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant special power are not affected by Searing Intensity.

name: Negative Element
text: A Fire Elemental can never roll defense dice while it is on a water space.

name: DRONE-DEPLOYED BOMBS
text: Start the game with 4 Remote Bomb Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card. At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may place a Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph from this Army Card power-side up onto a space within 6 spaces of Firefly.

name: DETONATE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range Special. Attack 4.\nChoose 1 Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph on the battlefield. All figures within 1 space of the chosen Glyph are affected, regardless of engagement and line of sight. Roll once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures do not have height advantage against this attack. After this attack is resolved, remove the chosen Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph from the game.

name: DEFUSE 10
text: Firefly may add 10 to his 20-sided die rolls for Traps and to pick up Treasure Glyphs.

name: PHANTOM WALK
text: Firefly can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

name: GLIDE IN 11
text: Flint does not start the game on the battlefield. If Flint has not been placed on the battlefield, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, place Flint on an empty space. You cannot place Flint adjacent to other figures or on Glyphs. Then you may move any or all of your unrevealed Order Markers to this Army Card.

name: TACTICAL ACUMEN
text: When Flint or a G.I. JOE or Soldier figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Flint defends, it increases its Defense Value by 1 if Flint has height advantage on the attacking figure.

name: FIRE WHEN READY
text: At the end of your Player Turn, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take a turn with Frizzt Galagan. No other Army Card may take this turn instead of Frizzt. If Frizzt moves during this turn, he cannot attack.

name: RA-1A GUIDED CANNON SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 10. Attack 2.\nRA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack can target only figures that are adjacent to one or more figures you control. Figures never have height advantage against RA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack.

name: SWIM
text: Frizzt does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space.

name: Indomitable
text: If this Frost Giant of Morh begins its turn unengaged, add 2 to its Move value this turn. If it begins its turn engaged, add 2 to its Attack value this turn.

name: Battle Frenzy
text: After attacking with this Frost Giant of Morh, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may attack again with this Frost Giant of Morh.

name: Dying Swipe
text: If this Frost Giant of Morh is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent's figure and receives enough wounds to be destroyed, roll 3 attack dice. One at a time for each skull rolled, you may inflict 1 wound on any figure that is adjacent to this Frost Giant of Morh. Figures affected by Dying Swipe cannot roll any defense dice and can receive more than 1 wound each. After using Dying Swipe, remove this Frost Giant of Morh from the battlefield.

name: Run 3
text: Before Moving a Frostclaw Paladin, you may add 3 to that figure's Move value. If you do, subtract 2 from that figure's Attack value this turn.

name: Jandar Champion Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with the Frostclaw Paladins, you may take a turn with a Champion you control who follows Jandar.

name: Climb X3
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Fyorlag Spiders may triple their height.

name: Entangling Web
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any one small or medium opponent's figure that is engaged with at least three Fyorlag Spiders that you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common Army Card for that figure).

name: Predator Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Fyorlag Spiders, you may first take a turn with any Predator you control. (Sujoah or any Wyvern).

name: TIDAL ADVANCE
text: At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may move each Fierce and Unfathomable figure you control up to 1 space for each each of your Order Markers on the Gelryie Vanguards.

name: DEFEND THE DEEP
text: A Gelryie Vanguard adds 2 to its Defense Value when it is on a water space or when it defends against an attack from a figure that has height advantage.

name: SWIM
text: Gelryie Vanguards do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.

name: DRACONIC ENGINEERING
text: Gimbal starts each game with the B.R.E.A.T.H., W.I.N.G.S., and C.L.A.W.S. Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card. These Treasure Glyphs cannot be placed on this Army Card except by this power. Gimbal cannot drop these glyphs except when destroyed or with the Ablative Equipment Special Power.

name: ABLATIVE EQUIPMENT
text: When Gimbal would take 1 or more wounds, you may place a B.R.E.A.T.H., W.I.N.G.S, or C.L.A.W.S. Treasure Glyph on this Army Card onto an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Gimbal. If you do, ignore all wounds.

name: COMMAND FAMILIAR
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Girushia, Grove Keeper, before taking Girushia’s turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

name: WICKED THORNS
text: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Girushia on a space where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 10 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also suffers one wound.

name: REACH
text: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of Girushia, and its level is no more than 9 levels above or 3 levels below Girushia's level, Girushia may add 1 to his Range Value when attacking that figure.

name: GIFT OF THE FOREST
text: At the end of a round, if Girushia is next to a tree or bush, you may remove one Wound Marker from this Army Card.

name: Cyberclaw
text: All small or medium opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to any Gladiatron may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.

name: Melee Defense 1
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Gladiatron adds 1 die.

name: Hanwi's Darkness
text: When you reveal an Order Marker, you may also reveal the "X" Order Marker on Glinerva the Kyrie Warrior to activate Hanwi's Darkness. Until you next reveal an Order Marker, Glinerva and all Small, Medium, and Large figures within 5 spaces of her cannot target or be targeted by non-adjacent figures with a normal or special attack.

name: CONCEALMENT 17
text: If Glinerva is targeted and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and Glinerva. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore those wounds.

name: MIGHTY HERO BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with the Gnarlfur Raiders, you may first take a turn with a Valiant or Relentless Hero you control whose Affiliation is Utgar or Jandar.

name: BROTHERS IN BLOOD
text: Increase the Move, Attack, and Defense Values of this Army Card by 1 for each of your destroyed Gnarlfur Raiders.

name: Mob Attack
text: When attacking with a Goblin Cutter you control, if the defending figure is engaged with at least 2 other Goblin Cutters you control, it subtracts 2 from its defense dice.

name: Scurry
text: When a Goblin Cutter you control is destroyed by a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move 2 Goblin Cutters you control up to 4 spaces each, and all Goblin Cutters you control no longer have any visible Hit Zones for the duration of the attacking figure's turn while they remain unengaged. Goblin Cutters will never take any leaving engagement attacks when using Scurry.

name: Scale
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Goblin Cutters may add 2 to their height.

name: Tough
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Gorillinators always add one automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

name: Rock Throw
text: If a Granite Guardian has a height advantage on an opponent's figure, it may add 2 to its range when attacking that figure.

name: Landslide
text: A Granite Guardian with a height advantage on an adjacent opponent's figure rolls an additional attack die when attacking that figure.

name: Gain High Ground
text: After taking a turn with Granite Guardians, you may move each Granite Guardian you control up to 1 space. This space may be up to 4 levels higher.

name: Guide of the Dead
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with a Grave Grim, you may move up to 6 Small, Medium, or Large Undead or Eisenek figures you control up to 3 spaces each.

name: Harrowing Presence
text: When an opponent rolls the 20-sided die for a Special Power on one of their Army Cards, if one or more of that Army Card's figures are within 3 spaces of a figure you control with the Harrowing Presence special power, they must subtract 3 from their roll.

name: LONGSHOT SPECIALISTS
text: When a Greatbow Archer that has not moved this turn attacks a figure at Range 4 or greater, add 1 to her Attack Value. If the target figure is at Range 7 or greater, instead add 2 to her Attack Value.

name: Ice Cold
text: While a Greater Ice Elemental is on a water or ice space, that space and all same-level water spaces adjacent to that Greater Ice Elemental are considered normal ice spaces. Figures do not have to stop their movement on normal ice spaces.

name: Ice Spikes 15
text: If an opponent's figure moves adjacent to this Greater Ice Elemental, roll the 20-sided die. If this Greater Ice Elemental is on at least one ice or snow space, add 2 to your die roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound. Figures can be affected by Ice Spikes only as they move into engagement with this Greater Ice Elemental.

name: Cold Healing
text: After taking a turn with this Greater Ice Elemental, if it is on at least one snow or ice space, remove 1 wound marker from this Greater Ice Elemental's Army Card.

name: LOYALTY TO THE LIZARD KING
text: At the start of the game, choose a Unique Lizardfolk Hero or Unique Large or Huge Dragon in your Army to be the Greenscale Warriors’ Lizard King. A Greenscale Warrior adds 1 to its Attack and Defense Values while its chosen Lizard King is within 2 clear sight spaces.

name: Lizard King Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with the Greenscale Warriors, you may first take a turn with their chosen Lizard King if it is still under your control.

name: WHEREVER THERE'S TROUBLE
text: Before taking a turn with Greenshirts, you may move up to 2 unengaged G.I. JOE or Soldier Heroes you control up to 2 spaces.

name: CHOMP
text: Before attacking, you may choose 1 small or medium figure adjacent to Grimnak. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.

name: Orc Warrior Enhancement
text: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Grimnak roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

name: Marro Warlord Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Grok Riders, you may first take a turn with any Marro Warlord you control.

name: Mark of the Warlord
text: When attacking a figure that is adjacent to any Marro Warlord, Grok Riders add 2 to their attack dice.

name: Grok Training
text: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Grok Riders with its rebirth special power.

name: DOUBLE ATTACK
text: Once per turn, after attacking with Guilty McCreech, he may make 1 additional normal attack.

name: DEPUTIZE
text: At the start of the game, you may place a silver Badge Marker on 1 Unique Hero in your Army that is a Sniper or follows Einar or Volarak. For this game, it gains the Class of Lawman.

name: LONG ARM OF THE LAW
text: Once per turn, before, during, or after moving normally, you may choose a Treasure Glyph within 3 clear sight spaces and place that Glyph power-side up on Guilty's Army Card or the Army Card of a friendly Unique Lawman Hero within 3 clear sight spaces of Guilty. Do not roll for traps on Treasure Glyphs collected with Long Arm of the Law.

name: Double Attack
text: When Guilty McCreech attacks, he may attack one additional time.

name: EXPEDITION LEADER
text: Gung-Ho and friendly figures within 2 clear sight spaces may choose to ignore any effects from terrain tiles they move onto or occupy other than molten lava.

name: COMBAT CHALLENGE
text: Figures engaged with Gung-Ho cannot make an attack unless that attack affects an engaged figure with the Combat Challenge special power.

name: NO FEAR, ALL FIGHT
text: Gung-Ho increases his Attack and Defense Values by 1 for each figure he is engaged with.

name: EVIL EYE DEFENSE
text: When Gurei-Oni successfully defends against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, inflict 1 wound on the attacking figure for each excess shield.

name: Tetsubo Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one figure adjacent to the targeted figured to be attacked by the Tetsubo Special Attack as well. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

name: DOUBLE DIABLO GUN
text: This figure can target non-adjacent figures even while engaged. Once per turn, after attacking with this figure, it may make one additional normal attack.

name: BATTLE READY
text: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on H.I.S.S. Tank. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.

name: TANK MOVEMENT
text: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.

name: COMMAND OF THE WILD
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Haluchott, Corruptor of Beasts, before taking Haluchott’s turn, you may take a turn with up to two Small, Medium, or Large Beasts you control.

name: STAFF OF THE LONG HAND SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 6. Attack 2.You may use the Staff of the Long Hand Special Attack before or after using Haluchott's normal attack.

name: CALM THE BEAST
text: While defending against an attack from a Beast, Haluchott increases her Defense Value by 2.

name: Command Familiar
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Halushia, Scion of the Wild, before taking Halishia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

name: Rouse The Glade
text: Figures adjacent to a tree or bush roll one fewer Combat Die when defending against Halushia's attacks.

name: Ride-By Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Halushia, you may move him up to 3 times with Ride-By Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as he is on a space where he can end his movement. Halushia cannot attack the same figure more than once in a single turn with Ride-By Special Attack. When using Ride-By Special Attack, Halushia is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: TOSS 11
text: After moving normally with a Hand of Hrungnir, you may choose a Small or Medium figure adjacent to that Hand. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may place that figure on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of that Hand. A figure moved by Toss does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: DEATHCLAP SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Line Special. Attack 5.\nIf your Hands are in a straight line and there are no more than 6 spaces between them, instead of making a normal attack with each Hand, choose 1 Hand to use Deathclap Special Attack. All figures in a straight line between both Hands are affected by Deathclap Special Attack.

name: STALWART DEFENSE AURA
text: When another Einar figure you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro defends, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. Once per Player Turn after rolling defense dice, you may choose to count each Einar symbol rolled as an additional shield.

name: ADJACENT EINAR RESOLVE 1
text: When Hatamoto Taro defends, if he is adjacent to at least 1 Einar figure you control, add 1 automatic shield to the roll.

name: HEROIC DEFENSE AURA
text: When another Samurai or Ashigaru figure you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro defends against a normal attack from a figure adjacent to it, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. Each Einar symbol rolled counts as an additional shield.

name: ADJACENT EINAR RESOLVE 1
text: When Hatamoto Taro defends, if he is adjacent to at least 1 Einar figure you control, add 1 automatic shield to the roll.

name: UNITED BODY
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Head of Hrungnir, you may first take a turn with 2 other different Relic Army Cards you control. Any figures activated by United Body must be within 7 spaces of Head of Hrungnir to be activated.

name: GIANT EVIL EYE
text: When Head of Hrungnir or a Relic figure you control within 7 spaces successfully defends against a normal attack from a figure that is within clear sight of Head of Hrungnir and is not adjacent to a Relic you control, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: THUNDEROUS HEARTBEAT SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range Special. Attack 2.\nThunderous Heartbeat Special Attack affects all enemy figures within 7 spaces that are adjacent to Relics you control, regardless of line of sight. Roll attack dice once. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures never have height advantage against Thunderous Heartbeat Special Attack.

name: BOUND BY THE OLD MAGIC
text: When another Relic figure you control within 7 spaces would take 1 or more wounds, you may ignore those wounds. If you do, the Heart of Hrungnir takes an equal number of wounds.

name: Orc Champion Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Heavy Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Orc Champion you control.

name: Disengage
text: Heavy Gruts are never attacked when leaving engagements.

name: Force Orb Special Attack
text: Range 5 Attack 3 Choose an opponent's figure to attack. Each opponent's figure adjacent to the chosen figure is also affected by Force Orb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

name: Mage Hand
text: After moving and before attacking with Heirloom, you may choose a Treasure Glyph on an unoccupied space within 4 spaces of Heirloom. You may move that Treasure Glyph onto an empty same-level space adjacent to Heirloom. Symbol-side-up Treasure Glyphs cannot be revealed, and power-side-up Treasure Glyphs must be placed power-side-up when moved by Heirloom.

name: Warforged Resolve
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Heirloom always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

name: Blast Furnace 15
text: During Hellforge Mandukor's turn, before moving it and each time it moves onto a space during this movement, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Hellforge. If you a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant Special Power are not affected by Blast Furnace. Hellforce cannot roll for Blast Furnace against the same figure more than once per turn.

name: Feed The Forge 15
text: If a figure or destructible object adjacent to Hellforge is destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add 8 to the roll if the figure is an Eisenek, Soulborg, or destructible object. If you roll 15 or higher, you may remove a Wound Marker from this card.

name: Eisenek Advance
text: At the start of each round after all Order Markers have been placed, if all your Order Markers are placed on Eisenek Army Cards, you may move Hellforge up to 4 spaces. Hellforge must end this movement on an empty space.

name: EXPENDABLE RABBLE
text: If a Horned Skull Brute you control is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent’s figure and would receive 1 or more wounds, you may destroy a small Goblin figure you control that is adjacent to that Horned Skull Brute to ignore those wounds.

name: Barge Into Battle
text: After moving and before attacking, if a Horned Skull Brute you control ends its movement unengaged, you may choose an engaged small or medium friendly squad figure within 3 clear sight spaces of that Horned Skull Brute whose base is no more than 2 levels higher or lower than the base of the Horned Skull Brute. You may switch that Horned Skull Brute with the chosen squad figure. Figures moved by Barge Into Battle never take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Ice Troll Charge
text: After moving and before attacking with this Ice Troll Berserker, roll the 20-sided die. If this Ice Troll Berserker is on a snow or ice space, add 3 to your die roll. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may move this Ice Troll Berserker again.

name: Cold Regenerate
text: After taking a turn with this Ice Troll Berserker, remove 1 wound marker from this Ice Troll Berserker's Army Card. If it is on a snow or ice space, remove 1 additional wound marker.

name: Stomp 8
text: Once during Imperator Kayne's turn, at any point during his normal movement that he is on a space where he could end his movement, you may choose an adjacent Small or Medium figure whose level is no more than 5 levels above Kayne's level and roll the 20-sided die: If you roll 8 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.

name: RAGE SMASH 5
text: When Incredible Hulk attacks using a normal attack, he receives one extra attack die for each Wound Marker he has, up to a maximum of 5 extra attack dice for Rage Smash.

name: SUPER LEAP
text: Instead of his normal move, Incredible Hulk may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Hulk's Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Hulk may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Hulk may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Hulk is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Hulk rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.

name: STOMP SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 1. Attack 3.
Any figure adjacent to Incredible Hulk is affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately. Hulk cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses Super Leap.

name: Iron Tough
text: When rolling defense dice against a Special Attack, this Iron Golem always adds 2 automatic shields to whatever is rolled.

name: Lava Resistant
text: This Iron Golem never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

name: Dismissive Strider
text: Iron Lich Viscerot can move through small and medium figures, does not take leaving engagement attacks from small and medium figures, and can target and attack non-adjacent figures while only engaged with small and medium figures.

name: Vile Injection
text: Begin the game with 3 yellow Surge Markers on this Army Card. Once per turn, before moving with another Eisenek figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Viscerot, you may remove a Surge Marker from this card to add 2 to that figure's Move and Attack until the end of the turn.

name: Ironclad Puppeteer
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Viscerot and taking a turn with Viscerot, you may take a turn with another Unique Eisenek Hero or Squad you control.

name: DOUBLE ATTACK
text: When Iron Man attacks, he may attack one additional time.

name: FLYING
text: When counting spaces for Iron Man's movement, ignore elevations. Iron Man may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iron Man starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Vanish 9
text: If Isamu is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to vanish. If you roll 1-8, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 9 or higher, Isamu takes no damage and may immediately move up to 4 spaces. Isamu can vanish only if he ends his vanishing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Isamu can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Dishonorable Attack
text: When attacking a figure who follows Jandar, Isamu rolls 2 additional attack dice.

name: ETERNAL SERVITUDE
text: Isamu cannot be destroyed by wounds on this Army Card except during the end of a round.

name: PHANTOM WALK
text: Isamu can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

name: Life Drain
text: Each time Iskra Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Iskra Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.

name: Summon the Rechets of Bogdan
text: After taking a turn with Iskra Esenwein, you may attempt to summon the Rechets of Bogdan if they are in your army and they have not yet been successfully summoned. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you must place all 3 Rechets of Bogdan on empty spaces within 6 clear sight spaces of Iskra Esenwein. Any Rechets of Bogdan that you cannot place on the battlefield are immediately destroyed and cannot be summoned again. When the Rechets of Bogdan are summoned, you may immediately take a turn with them.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When an Izumi Samurai successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: Shotgun Blast Special Attack
text: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figures are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. James only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. James cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

name: Whip 12
