text: After moving and before attacking, choose a small or medium figure adjacent to James. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by James this turn.

name: SHIELD OF FAITH 13
text: If this figure would be affected by an attack, after attack dice are rolled, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, ignore all wounds figures you control would take from that attack. If you used Shield of Faith 13, this figure cannot roll defense dice against this attack.

name: FAITHFUL SPIRIT
text: When Jeanne d'Arc is destroyed, you may place her figure onto a Unique Army Card. While she is on that Army Card, that Army Card gains the Shield of Faith 13 special power. If a figure from that Army Card rolls a 1–6 for Shield of Faith 13, remove Jeanne from that Army Card.

name: REACH
text: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of Jeanne, and its base is no more than 3 levels above Jeanne's height or 3 levels below Jeanne's base, you may add 1 to her Range Value when attacking that figure.

name: LEARN FROM THE MASTER
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with this Squad, you may first take a turn with a Ninja Hero you control.

name: COORDINATED TAKEDOWN
text: While attacking, roll 1 additional attack die for each other friendly Ninja adjacent to the target.

name: PHANTOM WALK
text: Members of this Squad can move through all figures and never take leaving engagement attacks.

name: Shotgun Blast Special Attack
text: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. Johnny only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Johnny cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

name: Rain of Flame Special Attack
text: Range 7 Attack 1+ Special Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Rain of Flame Special Attack. Add 1 to Jorhdawn's attack dice for every additional Elf Wizard you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Jorhdawn, up to a maximum of +3 dice. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. Jorhdawn cannot be affected by her own Rain of Flame Special Attack.

name: Wild Swing Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Wild Swing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Jotun cannot be affected by his own Wild Swing Special Attack.

name: Throw 14
text: After moving and before attacking, choose one small or medium non-flying figure adjacent to Jotun. Roll the 20-sided die. if you roll a 14 or higher, you may throw the figure by placing it on any empty space within 4 spaces of Jotun. The figure must land within clear sight of Jotun. After the figure is placed, roll the 20-sided die for throwing damage. If you roll an 11 or higher, the thrown figure receives 2 wounds. If the figure is thrown onto a level higher than the height of Jotun or onto water, do not roll for throwing damage. The thrown figure does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: QUICK RELEASE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 4 Attack 4. \nKaemon Awa may attack up to 2 times with Quick Release Special Attack.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Kaemon Awa successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: SCAVENGER MOVEMENT COORDINATION
text: After taking a turn with Kaijaax, you may move up to 3 Scavenger figures you control up to 5 spaces each.

name: RADIOACTIVE
text: Non-Dracostacean figures within 2 spaces of Kaijaax reduce their Defense Value by 1.

name: INURED TO THE ELEMENTS
text: Kaijaax may choose to ignore any effects from terrain he moves onto or occupies.

name: DAIMYO'S COMMAND
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Kato Katsuro, instead of taking a turn with him, you may take a turn with up to 2 different Unique Samurai Army Cards you control. Kato Katsuro may be one of these. Any other figure that is taking a turn with Kato Katsuro's Command must be within clear sight of Kato Katsuro to be activated.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Kato Katsuro successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: KATO KATSURO'S COMMAND
text:
After revealing an Order Marker on Kato Katsuro, instead of taking a turn with him, you may take a turn with one of the following that you control:
● 1 Samurai Hero.
● 1 Samurai Squad.
● up to 2 Ashigaru Army Cards with different names.
Any figure that is taking a turn with Kato Katsuro's Command must be within clear sight of Kato Katsuro to be activated.

name: Mind Shackle 19
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Kee-Mo-Shi. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on the chosen figure's Army Card. If Kee-Mo-Shi is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.

name: TOXIC SKIN 17
text: At the end of Kee-Mo-Shi’s turn, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Kee-Mo-Shi. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure takes one wound. Soulborgs are not affected by Toxic Skin 17.

name: Healing Touch
text: After moving and before attacking, choose a wounded hero figure adjacent to Kelda. Then roll the 20-sided die to add or remove wound markers from the chosen figure's card: -If you roll 1, add 2 markers. -If you roll 2-5, remove one marker. -If you roll 6-17, remove up to 2 markers. -If you roll 18-20, remove all markers.

name: HIVE TUNNEL
text:
Instead of moving normally with Kha-Re-Ga, you may Hive Tunnel. Choose an empty space within 4 spaces that is no higher than 6 levels above or below her level, and place Kha-Re-Ga on that space. Then, roll the 20-sided die for each figure adjacent to Kha-Re-Ga. Add 1 for each Wound Marker on this Army Card.
- If you roll a 1–13, nothing happens.
- If you roll a 14–19, that figure receives 1 wound.
- If you roll a 20, that figure receives 3 wounds.
If Kha-Re-Ga is engaged when she starts to Hive Tunnel, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Relentless Assault
text: Each friendly figure adjacent to Khosumet with a relentless personality receives an additional attack die.

name: Unleashed Fury Enhancement
text: You may add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Unleashed Fury power on any Army Card.

name: Witchcraft Telekinesis
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose up to 2 different Small or Medium enemy figures within 5 clear sight spaces of Kilkorax the Kyrie Warrior. One at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each chosen figure. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll an 8 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax. Figures moved by Witchcraft Telekinesis never take leaving engagement attacks.

name: Blunderbuss Special Attack
text: Range 4. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Blunderbuss Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Killian Vane cannot be affected by his own Blunderbuss Special Attack.

name: Apparition
text: Figures must be within two spaces of Kita the Springrunner to target her with a normal or special attack.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Kita can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: THE CAPTAIN'S WAY
text: At the start of the game, choose a Unique Captain in your Army to be the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar's Captain for this game. When attacked by a non-adjacent figure, add 1 to the Defense Value of a Knave of the Silver Scimitar if their chosen Captain is within 4 clear sight spaces.

name: Captain's Orders
text: Before taking a turn with the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar, you may first take a turn with their chosen Captain or a Pirate Hero you control.

name: First Assault 1
text: When attacking with a Knave of the Silver Scimitar, if the defending figure was not adjacent to that Knave of the Silver Scimitar at the start of this turn, that Knave of the Silver Scimitar receives 1 additional attack die.

name: Disengage
text: Knaves of the Silver Scimitar are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Run 3
text: Before moving Knight Irene, you may add 3 to her Move value. If you do, subtract 2 from her Attack value this turn.

name: Overwhelm Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 3 + Special. You may attack twice with Overwhelm Special Attack. If you attack the same figure a second time, you may roll an additional attack die for the second attack. You may not use Overwhelm Special Attack if you used the Run Special Power this turn.

name: Crushing Blow
text: After moving and before attacking, you may inflict one wound on a Small or Medium Squad figure or a Small or Medium Common Hero adjacent to Knight Primus Adelbern.

name: HUMAN CHAMPION BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with Knights of Weston, you may first take a turn with a Human Champion you control.

name: A COWARD'S REWARD
text: Knights of Weston roll 1 additional die when making a leaving engagement attack.

name: CHARGING ASSAULT
text: Before moving with an unengaged Kozuke Samurai, you may add 3 to that Samurai's Move Value if that Samurai could move adjacent to an enemy figure with the increased Move Value. If a Samurai uses Charging Assault, it must end his movement adjacent to an enemy figure if possible.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Kozuke Samurai successfully defend against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: WARP SPACE
text: Instead of moving normally with a Krakenling, you may place that Krakenling on an empty space within 4 spaces. If a Krakenling is engaged when it starts to Warp Space, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: ELDRITCH SWITCH
text: After moving normally with a Krakenling, that Krakenling may switch spaces with an adjacent single-space figure. Figures moved by Eldritch Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: FLAILING TENTACLES
text: A Krakenling may attack up to 3 times on its turn. Reduce the number of attacks by 1 for each Wound Marker it has.

name: SWIM
text: Krakenlings do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.

name: INTO THE BASKET
text: Krampus starts the game with a Krampus' Basket Glyph on his Army Card. After moving and before attacking, you may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure adjacent to Krampus and roll the 20-sided die. If the figure is Common and you roll a 5 or higher, place that figure on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card. If it is Unique and you roll a 15 or higher, place that figure on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card.

name: OUT OF THE BASKET
text: After Krampus takes 1 or more wounds from an attack but is not destroyed, each player with 1 or more figures from their Army on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card may roll a 20-sided die. If they roll a 13 or higher, they may place 1 figure from their Army that is on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card onto an empty space within 1 of Krampus, or the nearest empty space.

name: Krampus' Basket
text:
Power Glyph

After Krampus is destroyed, place the Krampus’ Basket Glyph on the space he occupied if possible, or the closest empty space.

When this Glyph is on the battlefield, at the start of each Player Turn, that player may place a figure from their Army that is on this card onto the battlefield, as close to this Glyph as possible. If there are no figures remaining on this card, immediately destroy this Glyph. This is the only way this Glyph can be destroyed.

name: Stealth Dodge
text: When a Krav Maga Agent rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

name: Wounded Smash
text: When Krug attacks, he receives one extra attack die for each wound marker he has.

name: Double Attack
text: When Krug attacks, he may attack one additional time.

name: Ninjutsu Barrage Special Attack
text: Range 1 Attack 3 Instead of moving and attacking normally with Kumiko, you may move Kumiko up to 3 spaces. Kumiko can attack up to 3 times with Ninjutsu Barrage Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as Kumiko is on a space where she could end her movement. Kumiko cannot attack the same figure more than once on a single turn.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Kumiko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Summon Elemental
text: After moving and before attacking with Kurrok the Elementalist, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed small or medium Elementals on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.

name: Master of the Elements
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Kurrok the Elementalist, instead of taking that turn with Kurrok, you may take a turn with up to three small or medium Elementals you control that are within 8 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.

name: Strength of Oak Aura 1
text: All friendly Elves adjacent to Kyntela Gwyn add 1 to their defense dice.

name: MOTORIZED ZIPLINE
text: Start the game with 3 Zipline Glyphs on this card. Before and after moving normally, you may place up to 1 Zipline Glyph on an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Lady Jaye.

name: MASTER OF DISGUISE 14
text: The first time each turn that Lady Jaye is targeted for an attack by a Squad figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, Lady Jaye cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attacks this turn.

name: Vydar’s Range Enhancement Aura
text: All friendly figures with a range of 4 or more who follow Vydar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Laglor add 2 spaces to their Range number. Vydar’s Range Enhancement Aura does not affect Laglor.

name: Autoload Special Attack
text: Range 7. Attack 3. When attacking with Autoload Special Attack, you may roll Vydar Valkyrie Dice. If you roll at least one Vydar symbol, you may attack again using Autoload Special Attack.

name: Brutality Aura
text: When a Squad figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Loviatäk the Kyrie Warrior attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll all attack dice that did not show skulls. Brutality Aura may only be used once per turn.

name: DEADLY STRIKE
text: When rolling attack dice with Loviatäk, each skull rolled counts for one additional skull.

name: Dynastic Leadership
text: If you control Loviatäk and another Unique Kyrie Hero who follows Utgar, figures you control who follow Utgar increase their Move Value by 1.

name: CONCEALMENT 12
text: If a Lurking Hive Soldier is targeted and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and that Lurking Hive Soldier. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 12 or higher, ignore those wounds.

name: DISENGAGE
text: A Lurking Hive Soldier is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: HIGHLAND FURY
text: At the start of the game, choose a Human Champion you control to be the Chieftain for all MacDirk Warriors you control. While their Chieftain is on the battlefield, MacDirk Warriors you control increase their Attack Value by 1 for each Wound their Chieftain has. MacDirk Warriors cannot attack their Chieftain.

name: HUMAN CHAMPION BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with MacDirk Warriors, you may first take a turn with a Human Champion you control.

name: SUNDERSTONE'S CHARGE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range Special. Attack 4.\nInstead of moving and attacking normally with Maeve Sunderstone, you may move her up to 3 spaces. Then, move Maeve up to 5 spaces in a straight line, passing through all figures and taking no leaving engagement attacks. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through. Each figure rolls defense dice separately in the order they were moved through. Defending figures never have height advantage against Sunderstone's Charge Special Attack.

name: RUNEHAMMER OF MAEVE
text: After Maeve makes a normal attack against a single-space figure, if the defending figure is still adjacent, you may move that figure 1 space. Figures moved this way do not take leaving engagement attacks.

name: BLUDD'S BLASTER SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 5. Attack 0 + Special. Explosion 1.
Add 2 automatic skulls to the attack roll. Major Bludd is not
affected by his own Bludd’s Blaster Special Attack. Bludd
can use this attack only once per round.

name: Machine Pistol Special Attack
text: Range 7 Attack 2 Major Q10 may use this special attack 4 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.

name: Wrist Rocket Special Attack
text: Range 4 Attack 4 Major Q10 may use this special attack 2 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.

name: Full Barrage Special Attack
text: Range Special. Attack Special. When using Full Barrage Special Attack, Major Q11 may attack up to 3 times. Each attack must target a different figure and must use a different Range and Attack Value pair from the list below (in any order): - Range 7, Attack 2. - Range 5, Attack 3. - Range 3, Attack 4. Major Q11 cannot target the same figure more than once per turn with Full Barrage Special Attack.

name: Vydar's Hammer
text: When Major Q11 attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you choose one Small, Medium, or Large figure that is adjacent to the defending figure. If the defending figure receives any wounds from Major Q11's attack, the chose figure receives one wound.

name: Queglix Gun Special Attack
text: Range 6. Attack 1, 2 or 3. Major Q9 starts each turn with 9 attack dice. Choose any figure within range and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Major Q9 may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until he has rolled all 9 attack dice. Major Q9 may target the same or different figures with each attack.

name: Improved Cyberclaw
text: All small, medium or large opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to Major X17 may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.

name: Melee Defense 4
text: When rollling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, Major X17 adds 4 dice.

name: COMMAND FAMILIAR
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Marachott, Mind Whisperer, before taking Marachott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

name: STAFF OF CURUPIRAN
text: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Maruchott always adds 2 automatic skulls to whatever is rolled.

name: MARACHOTT'S WHISPER
text: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and taking a turn with Marachott, you may choose a Unique Hero within 2 spaces of Marachott. Roll the 20-sided die, adding 3 to the roll if you control that Hero. If you roll a 16 or higher, take temporary control of that Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. After taking that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. Any Order Markers that were on the chosen figure's Army Card stay on that card.

name: Life Drain
text: Each time Marcu Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Marcu Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.

name: Eternal Hatred
text: After revealing an order marker on this card, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, choose an opponent. That opponent will now control Marcu Esenwein for the remainder of your turn, but will not be able to view any unrevealed order markers on his card. At the end of that turn, control of Marcu returns to you. All order markers and figures that were on Marcu’s Army Card will stay on his Army Card.

name: Soldier Leadership
text: All Soldiers you control move one additional space.

name: Soldier Attack Enhancement
text: All friendly Soldiers adjacent to Marcus Decimus Gallus receive an additional attack die.

name: MARIEDIAN TARGETING
text: When a Mariedian Resistance figure attacks, it adds 1 to its Attack Value for each other Mariedian that attacked the targeted figure this Player Turn.

name: GUERRILLA DEFENSE
text: When a Mariedian Resistance figure defends, it adds 1 to its Defense Value for each other time a friendly Soldier has defended this Player Turn.

name: WILD PACK MOVEMENT
text: At the start of Marrden Hounds’ turn, roll the 20-sided die. Increase the Move Value of this card until the end of the Marrden Hound’s turn, as follows. If you roll a 1–3, add 1 to its Move Value. If you roll a 4–6, add 3 to its Move Value. If you roll a 7–20, add 7 its Move Value

name: Marro Plague
text: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to any Marrden Hounds you control. If you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Soulborgs and Wulsinu are not affected by the Marro Plague.

name: HIVELORD LIFE BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with Marrden Nagrubs, you may first take a turn with any Hivelord you control. At the start of that Hivelord’s turn, you may destroy 1 adjacent Marrden Nagrub you control. If you do, remove 1 Wound Marker from the chosen Hivelord’s Army Card.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Marrden Nagrubs may double their Height.

name: Cell Divide
text: When a Marro Divider you control receives one or more wounds from a Normal or Special Attack by an opponent's figure, you may roll the 20-sided die before removing that figure. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds that figure just received and, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed Marro Dividers on a same-level space adjacent to the defending Marro Divider.

name: Self Replicating
text: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Marro Dividers with its Marro Rebirth special power.

name: HIVE SWARM
text: At the start of Marro Drones’ turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1–12, you may move and attack with up to 3 Marro Drones you control. If you roll a 13–16, you may move and attack with up to 6 Marro Drones you control. If you roll a 17–20, you may move and attack with up to 9 Marro Drones you control.

name: Swamp Water Strength
text: When a Marro Drudge is on a swamp water space, add 1 to its attack and defense.

name: Swamp Water Tunnel
text: If a Marro Drudge ends its normal movement on a swamp water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level swamp water space within 5 spaces. If a Marro Drudge is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Hive Mind
text: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you may take a turn with any small or medium common Marro Squad you control before taking a turn with Marro Hive. Any figure that is taking a turn must be within 12 clear sight spaces of Marro Hive, prior to its movement.

name: Marro Rebirth
text: After taking a turn with Marro Hive, you may roll the 20-sided die. if you roll a 13 or higher, you may place any previously destroyed common Marro Squad figure from your army on an empty space adjacent to Marro Hive.

name: Stinger Drain
text: After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, you must destroy a Marro Stinger you control and you cannot attack this turn. If you roll a 5-9, add 0 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 10 or higher, add 1 to the attack value of this card.

name: Water Clone
text: Instead of attacking with all of the Marro Warriors, one at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each Marro Warrior in play. If you roll a 15 or higher, place a previously destroyed Marro Warrior on a same-level space adjacent to that Marro Warrior. Any Marro Warrior on a water space needs a 10 or higher to Water Clone. You may only Water Clone after you move.

name: MORTAL STRIKE
text: When an opponent’s Unique Hero takes 1 or more wounds from a normal attack from this Master of the Hunt, roll 1 combat die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, the defending figure takes 1 wound.

name: Javelin
text: After moving and before attacking with this Master of the Hunt, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, add 3 to this Master of the Hunt's Range value for the duration of its turn.

name: Master's Influence
text: All Monk squad figures you control may leap an additional 13 levels up or down when using their Stealth Leap special power. All Monks you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Master Woo add 1 to their attack dice and 1 to their defense dice.

name: Master's Assault
text: Master Woo may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

name: Stealth Leap 25
text: Instead of his normal move, Master Woo may use Stealth Leap 25. Stealth Leap 25 has a move of 3. When counting spaces for Stealth Leap 25, ignore elevations. Master Woo may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Master Woo may not leap more than 25 levels up or down in a single leap. If Master Woo is engaged when he starts his Stealth Leap, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Paralyzing Stare 16
text: After moving and before attacking, choose any small or medium figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Me-Burq-Sa. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by Me-Burq-Sa this turn.

name: Poison Cloud
text: When a Mezzodemon Warmonger attacks a Common figure, add 1 to its attack value.

name: Exoskeleton
text: At the start of the game, place 1 copper Exoskeleton marker on a Mezzodemon Warmongers Army Card for each Mezzodemon Warmonger figure in your Army. After a Mezzodemon Warmonger rolls defense dice against a normal attack, you may remove 1 Exoskeleton marker from its Army Card to ignore all wounds inflicted by that attack.

name: STEALTH ARMOR 15
text: When a Microcorp Agent would take 1 or more wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore those wounds.

name: Water Suits
text: Microcorp Agents do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space. Add 2 to a Microcorp Agent's defense while he is on a water space.

name: Sighting
text: When a Microcorp Agent is attacking with a height advantage, he rolls an additional attack die.

name: Double Attack
text: Once per turn, after attacking with Mielki the Kyrie Warrior, she may make one additional normal attack.

name: Spear of Sankari
text: When Mielki destroys a figure with a normal attack, you may choose a Small or Medium friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Mielki. Remove a Wound Marker from the chosen figure. Mielki cannot heal herself with Spear of Sankari, and it cannot be used when destroying a destructible object.

name: DEADLY STRIKE
text: When rolling attack dice with Migol Ironwill, each skull rolled counts for one additional skull.

name: ONE SHIELD DEFENSE
text: When comparing Migol Ironwill’s shield results to an attacker’s skull results, if there are more skull results then shield results and at least one shield was rolled, Migol blocks all skulls except for 1.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Migol Ironwill may double his Height.

name: Shadow Ambush
text: If Mika Connour starts her turn unengaged and on a shadow space, add 3 to her attack this turn.

name: Shadow Dance
text: If Mika Connour starts her turn on a shadow space, instead of moving normally, you may place her on any other empty shadow space within 8 spaces of her current location. If Mika Connour is engaged when she starts her Shadow Dance, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Blend Into Shadow
text: Mika Connour starts each game with up to 2 shadow tiles on her Army Card (included in expansion pack). If Mika Connour ends her turn on an empty land space, you may place a shadow tile from her Army Card onto the space she occupies if the shadow tile fits normally onto that space.

name: FIRE LINE SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Attack 4, Line 8.

name: Psionic Blast Special Attack
text: Range 3 Attack 3. This Mind Flayer Mastermind does not need clear line of sight to attack with Psionic Blast Special Attack. If a figure recieves 1 or more wounds from Psionic Blast Special Attack, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from that figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common card for that figure).

name: Enslave 17
text: When revealing an order marker on this Mind Flayer Mastermind, after taking this Mind Flayer Mastermind's turn, you may choose any Unique Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of this Mind Flayer Mastermind. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take temporary control of the chosen Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. At the end of that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. All order markers that were on the figure's Army Card will stay on the Army Card. Enslave does not affect Mindflayers.

name: CLUSTER CANNON SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 6. Attack 2.\nThis figure may attack up to 4 times with Cluster Cannon Special Attack.

name: BATTLE READY
text: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Mini Tank Armadillo. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.

name: TANK MOVEMENT
text: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.

name: Utgar's Orders
text: Instead of taking a turn with the Minions of Utgar, you may take a turn with any Kyrie Warrior you control who follows Utgar.

name: DEADLY STRIKE
text: When rolling attack dice with a Minion of Utgar, each skull rolled counts for one additional skull.

name: Life Drain
text: Each time this figure destroys a figure, you may remove a Wound Marker from this Army Card. This figure cannot Life Drain destructible objects.

name: Life Drain Spirit
text: When Misaerx the Kyrie Warrior is destroyed, place this figure on the Army Card of a Unique Warrior that follows Revna. That Hero now has Life Drain.

name: Combat Leader
text: If at least one order marker is on Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may add 3 to your initiative roll.

name: Commander's Strike
text: After moving and before attacking with Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces that is engaged with any other figure you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.

name: Tough
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Mogrimm Forgehammer always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

name: Battle Fury
text: If a Mohican Rive Tribesman is engaged, add 1 to his attack dice and 2 to his defense dice.

name: War Cry
text: After taking a turn with the Mohican River Tribe, if at least two Mohican River Tribesmen you control are engaged, you may immediately take a turn with one Unique Tribesman Hero you control.

name: CONCEALMENT 19
text: When a Mohican River Tribesman you control is targeted by and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure that is not adjacent, roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and the Mohican River Tribesman. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 19 or higher, ignore those wounds.

name: Volcanic Carapace
text: Being the game with three 1-hex lava field tiles and one 1-hex molten lava tile for every Squad of Molten Crustaceans in your Army. After a Molten Crustacean you control is destroyed by a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, you must roll the 20-sided die and place one of these tiles onto the space the figure occupied, if the tile fits normally on that space. If you roll a 19 or higher place a molten lava tile, if able. Otherwise place a lava field tile.

name: Lava Resistant
text: Molten Crustaceans are not affected by lava field or molten lava spaces, and do not have to stop their movement on molten lava spaces.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Molten Crustaceans may double their Height.

name: Burning Breath Special Attack
text: Range 4 Special Attack 4 Choose a figure to attack, you may also choose 4 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. All figures on those spaces that are within line of sight of Moltenclaw are affected by Burning Breath Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately, Moltenclaw is not affected by Burning Breath Special Attack. See Mimring for more details.

name: Lava Resistant
text: Moltenclaw never rolls for molten lava damage and lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Moriko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Saber Storm Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 1, 2 or 3 Moriko starts each turn with 6 attack dice. Choose any adjacent figure and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Moriko may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until she has rolled all 6 attack dice. Moriko may target the same or different figures with each attack.

name: PROMETHEAN CREATION
text: Morinstein's Masterpiece does not start the game on the battlefield. He must be created by Dr. Torvik Morinstein.

name: UNBELIEVABLE RAGE
text: After taking a turn with a Scientist or Wizard Hero you control, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 4 or higher, immediately take a turn with Morinstein's Masterpiece. If you roll a 1–3, you must choose another player to immediately take a turn with Morinstein's Masterpiece. After Morinstein's Masterpiece takes a turn with Unbelievable Rage, you cannot take another turn during that Player Turn.

name: RESOLVE
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Morinstein's Masterpiece always adds 1 automatic shield.

name: Rod of Negation
text: Start the game with 3 brown Negation Markers on this card. At the end of the turn, if you have at least 1 Negation Marker on this card, you may choose any opponent's unique figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Morsbane. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16-19, place a Negation Marker on the chosen figure's Army Card. All of that figure's special powers are negated for the entire game. If you roll a 20, destroy the chosen figure.

name: Smoke Powder 13
text: When any Nakita Agent you control, or any figure you control that is adjacent to any Nakita agent you control, is targeted for a normal attack from a non-adjacent opponent, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, all Nakita Agents you control, and all figures you control that are adjacent to those Nakita Agents, no longer have any visible hit zones for the duration of the targeting figure’s turn.

name: Engagement Strike 15
text: If an opponent’s small or medium figure moves adjacent to a Nakita Agent, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent’s figure receives a wound. Figures may only be targeted as they move into engagement with a Nakita Agent.

name: Gorillinator Movement Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Nakita Agents, you may move 3 Gorillinators you control up to 7 spaces each.

name: Mind Shackle 20
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Ne-gok-sa. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on this card. If Ne-Gok-Sa is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.

name: UNSTABLE BLASTER
text: After taking a turn with a Necrotech Geistfire, if that Geistfire attacked a non-adjacent figure, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1–5, that Geistfire receives 1 wound.

name: WILD SPIN SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 1. Attack 4.\nIf a Necrotech Ghastblade attacks with Wild Spin Special Attack, it must attack all adjacent figures. Roll each attack separately.

name: CYBERCLAW
text: Small and Medium figures engaged with a Necrotech Ghoulgrip cannot move or be moved by any special power or glyph.

name: MELEE DEFENSE 1
text: A Necrotech Ghoulgrip adds 1 to its Defense Value when attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure.

name: NECROTIC NETWORK
text: Before taking a turn with Necrotech Reavers, you may first take a turn with an Eisenek Hero you control. If that Hero is Unique, you may only activate 1 Necrotech Reaver.

name: SCAVENGED PARTS
text: At the start of the round, before placing Order Markers, you may replace 1 Necrotech Reaver you control with 1 of your destroyed Common Medium Eisenek Heroes.

name: Chain Grab 9
text: After moving and before attacking with the Necrotech Wraithriders, one at a time, each Wraithrider may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose base is no more than 11 levels above that Wraithrider's level or 6 levels below that Wraithrider's level. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to that Wraithrider. Figures moved by Chain Grab do not take leaving engagement attacks. A figure can only be moved by Chain Grab once each turn.

name: Rolling Movement
text: A Necrotech Wraithrider cannot move onto a space more than 2 levels above its level.

name: Disengage
text: Nerak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Orc Defensive Aura 1
text: All Orc figures you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Nerak add 1 to their defense dice. Nerak's Orc Defensive Aura does not affect Nerak.

name: Snow Strength
text: Add 1 to Nerak's attack and defense while on a snow space.

name: Ice Shard Breath Special Attack
text: Range 5. Attack 4. When Nilfheim attacks with his Ice Shard Breath Special Attack, he may attack 2 additional times. He cannot attack the same figure more than once.

name: Disappearing Ninja
text: If a Ninja of the Northern Wind is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to disappear. If you roll 1-11, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 12 or higher, that Ninja of the Northern Wind takes no damage and instead may move up to 4 spaces. Ninjas of the Northern Wind can disappear only if they end their disappearing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.

name: Ghost Walk
text: Ninjas of the Northern Wind can move through all figures.

name: Disengage
text: Ninjas of the Northern Wind are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: SAMURAI HERO BONDING
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Nishi Souta, you may take a turn with another Samurai Hero you control.

name: CALL FOR BACKUP
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and taking a turn with Souta, if he is within 5 clear sight spaces of an enemy figure, you may take a turn with another Lawman Hero you control that has not activated this Player Turn.

name: SWORDCATCHER
text: If Souta is engaged with exactly 1 enemy figure and that figure is Small or Medium, that figure reduces its Attack and Defense Values by 1.

name: IMPROVED COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Souta successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, that figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: WITHERING BREATH SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Line 3. Attack 2 + Special.\nRoll 1 additional attack die for each wound on the attacking Nuckelavee.

name: SUBSUME SOUL
text: The first time a Nuckelavee destroys a figure each turn, you may remove a Wound Marker from that Nuckelavee. Subsume Soul cannot be used on destructible objects.

name: Become One
text: At the start of the game, if you have the Oathbound Phalanx in your army, then you may place any or all Oathbound Legionnaire figures on your Oathbound Phalanx Army Card instead of placing them normally. Instead of attacking with an Oathbound Legionnaire, if you control the Oathbound Phalanx and it is adjacent to that Legionnarie onto the Oathbound Phalanx's Army Card.

name: Disengage
text: Oathbound Legionnaries are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Oathbound Legionnaires may double their Height.

name: Break The Link
text: Before taking a turn with the Oathbound Phalanx, you may place any Oathbound Legionnaire figures you control from this Army Card onto any empty spaces adjacent to Oathbound Phalanx. After revealing an Order Marker on the Oathbound Phalanx and after taking a turn with it, you may take a turn with any Oathbound Legionnaires you control

name: One Falls, The Swarm Survives
text: When the Oathbound Phalanx would receive one or more wounds, you may remove an Oathbound Legionnaire figure from this Army Card and destroy it. If you do, ignore all wounds the Oathbound Phalanx would have received.

name: All as One Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 3. You may attack once for each Oathbound Legionnaire figure on this Army Card. When attacking a Small or Medium figure with All As One Special Attack, if you roll a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice and is immediately destroyed.

name: SEELIE KING
text: After revealing a numbered Order Marker on Oberon, instead of taking a turn with him, you may take a turn with a number of different Unique Dwarf, Elf, or Fey Army Cards you control equal to the number on the Order Marker you revealed. Oberon may be one of these. Figures other than Oberon taking a turn with Seelie King must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Oberon to be activated.

name: WELCOME, WANDERER
text: After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may place 1 friendly Dwarf, Elf, or Fey figure adjacent to Oberon. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may instead choose an enemy figure within 4 clear sight spaces and place it on a same-level space adjacent to Oberon. Figures moved with Welcome, Wanderer never take leaving engagement attacks.

name: Lava Resistant
text: Obsidian Guards never roll for molten lava damage or lava field damage and they do not have to stop in molten lava spaces.

name: Lava Throw
text: When an Obsidian Guard is on a molten lava space it may add 2 to its range.

name: Water Weakness
text: An Obsidian Guard on a water space rolls 2 fewer defense dice.

name: Double Attack
text: When this Ogre Pulverizer attacks, it may attack one additional time.

name: Lumbering Bully
text: When attacking with this Ogre Pulverizer, all excess shields rolled by the defending figure count as unblockable hits inflicted by the defending figure on this Ogre Pulverizer.

name: Flail Hurricane
text: After moving and before attacking with this Ogre Warhulk, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-10, it may attack normally. If you roll an 11 or higher, instead of attacking normally, it must attack each figure adjacent to it, if possible. Roll each attack separately.

name: Mine!
text: When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with this Ogre Warhulk, you must subtract 4 from your die roll.

name: Circuitry Overload
text: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20 sided die once for each Soulborg figure adjacent to any Omnicron Repulsors you control. If the figure is a squad figure and you roll a 13 or higher, destroy that figure. If the figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Omicron Repulsors are not affected by Circuitry Overload.

name: Targeting Beacon
text: When attacking a non-adjacent figure, all Soulborgs you control who follow Jandar add 1 extra die to their attack if at least one Omnicron Repulsor is adjacent to the defending figure.

name: EMP Response
text: If an Omnicron Repulsor you control successfully defends an attack by a Soulborg figure, you must roll the 20 sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, the attacking figure must immediately end its turn and all order markers must be removed from its Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one).

name: DEADLY SHOT
text: When rolling attack dice with an Omnicron Sniper, each skull rolled counts for one additional skull.

name: Sonic Blast Special Attack
text: Range 4. Attack 2. You may attack one additional time with Sonic Blast Special Attack.

name: HEIMDALL STATION COORDINATORS
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Orangunators, you may first take a turn with an Agent or Scientist Hero you control.

name: FLAMETHROWER SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Line 4. Attack 4.

name: FORCE FIELD 19
text: Orangunators always add 1 automatic shield to their defense rolls. When an Orangunator would take 1 or more wounds from an attack from a figure that is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Add the minimum number of spaces between the enemy figure and the defending Orangunator to the result. If you roll a 19 or 20, ignore those wounds.

name: Reload
text: If an Ordo Borealis does not move on its turn, it may add 6 to its Range Value for the rest of that turn.

name: Red Flag of Fury Aura
text: If Order Marker 1 is placed on Ornak, then instead of taking that turn with Ornak, you may take a turn with up to 2 Unique Heroes you control who follow Utgar. Ornak cannot be one of the 2 Unique Heroes. Any Unique Hero that is taking a turn instead of Ornak must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Ornak prior to its movement.

name: Orc Battle Cry
text: When attacking with any Orc Warrior figures you control adjacent to Ornak, you may roll Utgar Valkyrie dice. Each Utgar symbol rolled counts for an additional skull.

name: Acid Spray Special Attack
text: Range 4. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to two other figures adjacent to the targeted figure to be affected by Acid Spray Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

name: Lurking Ambush
text: If Othkurik starts his turn unengaged and on at least one shadow or swamp water space, for this turn add 1 to Othkurik's movement and 3 to his Attack value.

name: Tricky Speed 4
text: If Otonashi starts her turn adjacent to any figure you control with a "Tricky" personality, she may move 4 additional spaces.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Otonashi can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Attack the Wild 2
text: When attacking a figure who has a "Wild" personality, Otonashi rolls 2 additional attack dice.

name: DISCIPLINED INFLUENCE
text: At the start of the game, you may choose any Unique Army Card in your Army. For this game the chosen card’s personality is Disciplined, regardless of what is listed on the card.

name: SACRED BAND DEFY DEATH 15
text: When an adjacent Sacred Band figure you control would take 1 or more wounds, roll the 20-sided die before removing that figure. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore any wounds.

name: LOLTH’S WRATH
text: Before attacking with Pelloth, you may choose a Drow figure you control that is within 5 clear sight spaces of Pelloth and roll 3 attack dice. One at a time for each skull rolled, you may inflict 1 wound on any small or medium figure that is within 2 clear sight spaces of the chosen Drow figure. You may inflict more than 1 wound on a single figure using Lolth's Wrath. After using Lolth's Wrath, destroy the chosen Drow figure.

name: Lurk In Shadows
text: If Pelloth is on a shadow space, opponents' figures must be adjacent to attack him with a normal attack.

name: Insubstantial 3
text: A Phantom Knight rolls 3 additional defence dice when rolling defense against a normal attack from a figure who is not adjacent.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for a Phantom Knight's movement, ignore elevations. A Phantom Knight may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Phantom Knight is engaged when it starts to fly, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Combined Arbalest
text: When attacking with a Protector of Ullar, roll 1 additional attack die for each wound that has been inflicted on the defending figure this turn by Protectors of Ullar you control.

name: Feral Rage
text: When a Quasatch Hunter attacks, it may attack up to 2 additional times. A Quasatch Hunter cannot attack the same figure more than once per turn.

name: Techno Hatred
text: When attacking a Soulborg figure, Quasatch Hunters receive one additional attack die.

name: Jungle Tracking
text: If a Quasatch Hunter starts its turn next to an Evergreen Tree or a Jungle Piece, it may move 2 additional spaces.

name: Festering Honor Guard Bonding
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Queen Maladrix the Conqueror and before taking a turn with her, you may first take a turn with your Festering Honor Guard.

name: Double Attack
text: Once per turn, after attacking with Queen Maladrix, she may make one additional normal attack.

name: Infestation 9
text: After taking a turn with Queen Maladrix, you may choose a Unique Hero adjacent to Queen Maladrix that does not have a Festering Honor Guard on its Army Card and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, you may place one of your destroyed Festering Honor Guard on that Hero's Army Card.

name: Heart Finder Spear 12
text: Before attacking with Queen Qhyrion, you may roll 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, a figure attacked by Queen Qhyrion may roll no more than 1 die for defense.

name: Command Familiar
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Raakchott, Steward of Death, before taking Raakchott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

name: Consume the Dead
text: Start the game with 3 red Consume Markers. When a figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Raakchott is destroyed, place a Consume Marker on this Army Card. You cannot place more than one Consume Marker on this card each turn.

name: Soul Fury Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 2 + Special. All figures adjacent to Raakchott are affected by Soul Fury Special Attack. Add 1 to Raakchott's attack dice for each Consume Marker on this card. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Do not place any Consume Markers on this Army Card while using Soul Fury Special Attack. After using Soul Fury Special Attack, remove one Consume Marker from this Army Card for each figure you attacked this turn.

name: Terrifying Aura
text: While opponents' figures are within 4 clear sight spaces of Raelin the Kyrie Warrior, they lower their defense value by 1.

name: Twist the Blade
text: If Raelin inflicts at least 1 wound with a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, she inflicts 1 additional wound.

name: Unyielding
text: Other players cannont gain control of, move, or take turns with Raelin The Kyrie Warrior.

name: Whirlwind Assault
text: Raelin may attack any number of times during her turn. She cannot attack any figure more than once per turn.

name: Vengeful Swoop 8
text: Once per turn, after another figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Raelin defends against a normal attack from an enemy figure, if you received 1 or more wounds, you may place Raelin on an unoccupied space adjacent to the attacking figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 9 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Raelin does not take leaving engagement attacks when moved by Vengeful Swoop.

name: Defensive Aura
text: All figures you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Raelin add 2 to their defense dice. Raelin's Defensive Aura does not affect Raelin.

name: Whirlwind Assault
text: Raelin may attack any or all figures adjacent to her. Roll each attack separately.

name: Extended Defense Aura
text: All figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Raelin add 1 to their defense dice. Raelin's Extended Defensive Aura does not affect Raelin.

name: FIRST ASSAULT 1
text: When attacking with a Ramosaur Rider, if the defending figure was not adjacent to that Ramosaur Rider at the start of the turn, that Ramosaur Rider increases its Attack Value by 1.

name: HEADBUTT
text: After a Ramosaur Rider makes a normal attack, if there was an equal number of shields in the defense roll as skulls in the attack roll, Ramosaur Rider and the defender must each take 1 wound.

name: HYPNOSIS
text: When a Ranoc Viper attacks an adjacent figure, the defender reduces its Defense Value by 1 for each skull in the attacking Viper's roll. Hypnosis does not affect destructible objects.

name: EVASIVE 2
text: Ranoc Vipers increase their Defense Value by 2 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

name: SLITHER
text: Ranoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces

name: Iskra's Summoning
text: Rechets of Bogdan do not start the game on the battlefield. They must be summoned onto the battlefield by Iskra Esenwein.

name: Lethal Sting
text: When rolling attack dice against a small or medium figure, if a Rechet of Bogdan rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice and is immediately destroyed.

name: MASTER MANIPULATOR
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Red Skull's card, instead of taking that turn with Red Skull, you may take a turn with any Unique Hero you control within clear sight of Red Skull.

name: DUST OF DEATH
text:
After moving and before attacking you may either:
Roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Red Skull, or
Roll the 20-sided die once for any one figure up to 3 clear sight spaces away.
If you roll a 19 or higher, that figure is destroyed.

name: Fledgling Fires Special Attack
text: Range 5 Attack 3 Common Squad figures roll 2 fewer defense dice against Fledgling Fires Special Attack.

name: Wyrmling Bonding
text: After revealing an order marker on a Red Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that Red Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.

name: Net Trip 14
text: After moving and before attacking, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, any small or medium figure attacked by Retiarius this turn may roll no more than 1 die for defense.

name: BLOOD FOR BLOOD
text: After revealing an Order Marker on the Revenants of Revna, you may place a Wound Marker on a Warrior, Witch, or Scourge Hero you control who follows Revna. If you do, add 1 to the Attack Value of that Hero and all Revenants of Revna you control until the next time you reveal an Order Marker.

name: OCCULT BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with the Revenants of Revna, you may take a turn with a Warrior, Witch, or Scourge Hero you control who follows Revna.

name: Hero Worship
text: While a Hero you control who follows Revna attacks with a normal attack or defends, if that Hero is adjacent to one or more Revnan Acolytes you control, you may re-roll 1 die.

name: Risen By Revna
text: At the start of each round, before placing Order Markers, you may place one of your destroyed Revnan Acolytes onto an empty space adjacent to a Hero you control who follows Revna.

name: DRAGON BREATH SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Attack 3. Line 3.

name: Lay On Hands
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose a wounded friendly Hero figure adjacent to Rhogar Dragonspine and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen figure's Army Card.

name: DOUBLE DIABLO GUN
text: This figure can target non-adjacent figures even while engaged. Once per turn, after attacking with this figure, it may make one additional normal attack.

name: TANK MOVEMENT
text: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.

name: RIP RUSH 11
text: Instead of moving normally, you may move Rip It up to 8 spaces in a straight line. While moving with Rip Rush, Rip It may move through all Small, Medium, and Large figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks. After moving, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure moved through. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure takes 1 wound.

name: MACHINE GUN SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 5. Attack 3.\nRoadblock may attack up to 3 times with Machine Gun Special Attack. He cannot attack the same target more than once each turn.

name: ARROW VOLLEY
text: Special Attack - Range 6, Attack 6. Three unengaged adjacent Roman Archers on the same level may combine their attacks and roll their attack dice as one attack. All Roman Archers in the Arrow Volley must have a clear line of sight on the one target.

name: Warlord Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Roman Legionnaires, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control.

name: SHIELD WALL
text: When defending with a Roman Legionnaire, increase that Roman Legionnarie's Defense Value by 1 for each adjacent Roman Legionnaire you control, to a maximum of +2.

name: Helm of Mitonsoul Aura
text: After moving and before attacking, Runa may use her Helm of Mitonsoul Aura. When using the Helm of Mitonsoul Aura, you must roll the 20-sided die for all figures within 3 clear sight spaces of Runa, one at a time. If you roll a 20, destroy the figure. Runa's Helm of Mitonsoul Aura does not affect Runa.

name: Einar Warlord Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Sacred Band, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control who follows Einar.

name: Disciplined Army Defense Bonus
text: If every Army Card you control has a Disciplined personality, each soldier in the Sacred Band receives 1 additional defense die.

name: Blood Frenzy
text: When attacking with a Sahuagin Raider, it receives 1 additional attack die for each Wound Marker on the defending figure's Army Card, for a maximum of 3 additional attack dice for Blood Frenzy.

name: Amphibious
text: While a Sahuagin Raider is on a water space, add 2 to its defense. If a Sahuagin Raider starts its turn on a water space, add 1 to its movement for that turn. A Sahuagin Raider does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.

name: FIRE AND RUSH SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 5. Attack 3 + Special.\nFire and Rush Special Attack can only be used instead of moving and attacking normally, and only if Samuel Brown is unengaged. Once per turn, after attacking with Fire and Rush Special Attack, if the defending figure took 1 or more wounds, you may move Samuel up to 5 spaces. After moving, Samuel may attack a figure he is engaged with, rolling 1 additional die.

name: Spear of Summoning
text: After moving and before attacking, choose any figure you control on the battlefield, then roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-8, nothing happens. If you roll a 9-20, move the chosen figure to any space adjacent to Saylind. If the summoned figure is engaged, the figure does not receive any leaving engagement attacks.

name: NOW YOU KNOW
text: At the start of the round, after rolling Initiative, you may look at all unrevealed Order Markers on 1 enemy Army Card. Then you may move 1 Order Marker from a G.I. JOE or Soldier Army Card you control to another G.I. JOE or Soldier Army Card you control.

name: KNOWING IS HALF THE BATTLE
text: When Scarlett makes an attack, the target figure lowers its Defense Value by 1 for every revealed Order Marker on its Army Card.

name: LETHAL TO THE BONE
text: Once per turn, after attacking, you may move Scarlett up to 2 spaces and make 1 normal attack against an adjacent figure.

name: Double Burst Special Attack
text: Range 4. Attack 3. When Scavorith, Lord of Ruin attacks with Double Burst Special Attack, he may attack 1 additional time, targeting the same or different figures with each attack.

name: Battle Surge
text: After taking a turn with Scavorith, you may reveal an "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take 1 additional turn with Scavorith. You cannot use Double Burst Special Attack this additional turn. If Scavorith does not attack a figure during the additional turn, Scavorith suffers 1 wound.

name: CLEAVE TO THE MIGHTY
text: At the start of the game, choose an Archmage, Dragon, King, or Queen Unique Hero you control to be the Liege for all Scions of Icaria you control. Before taking a turn with the Scions of Icaria, you may take a turn with their chosen Liege.

name: DRACONIC BREATH
text: SPECIAL ATTACK Range 4. Attack 2.\nOnly figures within 3 clear sight spaces of the Scions of Icaria’s Liege can be targeted with Draconic Breath Special Attack.

name: TEENY-TINY
text: Seelie Courtiers may choose to have no Size for the purpose of enemy special powers or special attacks.

name: DANCING LIGHTS
text: Enemy figures adjacent to one or more of your Seelie Courtiers reduce their Defense Values by 1.

name: Shields of Valor
text: When defending with Sentinels of Jandar, each shield rolled counts for one additional block.

name: DOUBLE ATTACK
text: Once per turn, after attacking with Serpentor, he may make 1 additional normal attack.

name: CRUELTY FOR ITS OWN SAKE
text: Figures adjacent to Serpentor subtract 1 from their Defense Value.

name: I'LL DO IT MYSELF
text: Once per round, before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on an Army Card in your Army, you may move that Order Marker to Serpentor and reveal it.

name: Thorian Speed
text: Opponents' figures must be adjacent to Sgt. Drake Alexander to attack him with a normal attack.

name: Grapple Grab 8
text: After moving and before attacking with Drake, you may choose one enemy Small or Medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces whose level is no more than 6 levels above or below Drake's level. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, place the chosen figrue on any empty same-level space adjacent to Drake. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Grapple Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Thorian Speed
text: Opponents' figures must be adjacent to Sgt. Drake Alexander to attack him with a normal attack.

name: Grapple Gun 25
text: Instead of Sgt. Drake Alexander's normal move, he may move only one space. This space may be up to 25 levels higher. When using the Grapple Gun, all engagement rules still apply.

name: Thorian Speed
text: Opponents' figures must be adjacent to Sgt. Drake Alexander to attack him with a normal attack.

name: Grapple Arm
text: Instead of his normal move, Sgt. Drake Alexander may use his Grapple Arm. Grapple Arm has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Grapple Arm, ignore elevations. Drake may grapple over water without stopping, over figures wtihout becoming engaged, and over obstacles such as ruins. Drake may not grapple more than 45 levels up or down in a single Grapple Arm move. If Drake is engaged when he starts his Grapple Arm move, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Pistol Fire Special Attack
text: Range 5 Attack 3 Drake may not use Pistol Fire Special Attack to attack a figure who follows Jandar.

name: SOUL DEVOUR 19
text: At the start of Shades of Bleakewoode’s turn, each Shade of Bleakewoode you control may choose an adjacent Unique Hero. Roll the 20-sided die once for each Shade. If you roll a 19 or higher, destroy that Shade of Bleakewoode, then take control of the chosen Unique Hero and remove any Order Markers on its Army Card. You now control that Army Card.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for Shades of Bleakewoode's movement, ignore elevations. Shades of Bleakewoode may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Shade of Bleakwoode starts to fly, if it is engaged it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Shaolin Assault
text: A Shaolin Monk may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

name: Stealth Leap
text: Instead of their normal move, any or all Shaolin Monks may Stealth Leap. Stealth Leap has a move 3. When counting spaces for a Monk's leaping movement, ignore elevations. A Monk may leap over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. A Monk may not leap more than 12 levels up or down in a single leap. If a Monk is engaged when he starts to leap, he does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Arcane Bolt Special Attack
text: Range 5 + Special. Attack 3. The first target of Arcane Bolt Special Attack must be within a Range of 5. After attacking with Arcane Bolt Special Attack, if the defending figure receives at least 1 wound, you may choose a figure that was adjacent to the defending figure at the beginning of that attack and attack that chosen figure with Arcane Bolt Special Attack. You may continue attacking with Arcane Bolt Special Attack in this manner until you fail to inflict a wound. A figure cannot be attacked more than once in a turn with Arcane Bolt Special attack.

name: ARCANE RIPOSTE
text: When Sharwin Wildborn successfully defends against a normal attack, inflict 1 wound on the attacking figure for each excess shield.

name: Shocking Grasp
text: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Sharwin Wildborn always adds 1 automatic skull to whatever is rolled.

name: Ninjutsu Mastery Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 2+ Special. If Shiori did not move normally, she mayattack with Ninjutsu Mastery Special Attack up to three times. Before each attack, you must choose an opponent's figure within 2 clear sight paces of Shiori and place Shiori on an empty space adjacent to that figure that is not more than 6 spaces higher or lower than Shiori's base. When attacking with Ninjutsu Mastery Special Attack, Shiori rolls 2 attack dice, or 3 attack dice if Shiori has exactly one unrevealed Order Marker on her Army Card.

name: KIERU 14
text: If Shiori is attacked with a normal or special attack and would take 1 or more wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may place Shiori on an empty space within 2 spaces of Shiori that is not more than 6 levels above or below Shiori’s level. If you do, ignore those wounds.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Shiori can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving engagement.

name: Concentrated Will
text: If Shiori has only one unrevealed order marker on her Army Card, add 1 to her attack and defense.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Shiori can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Shuriken Special Attack
text: Range 5. Attack Special. If Shiori is attacking a small or medium figure, roll 3 attack dice for Shuriken Special Attack. If Shiori is attacking a figure of a different size or a destructible object, roll 2 attack dice for Shuriken Special Attack.

name: Sweeping Sword Special Attack
text: Range 1 Attack 5. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to both Shurrak and the chosen figure are also affected by Sweeping Sword Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

name: KNOCKBACK
text: After Shurrak attacks, you may roll the 20-sided die for each small or medium figure Shurrak attacked this turn that was not destroyed by that attack, one at a time. If you roll a 14 or higher, place that figure on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of Shurrak. The space must be on the same level as or lower than its current location. A figure moved by Knockback never takes any leaving engagement attacks. A non-flying figure moved lower by Knockback can take any falling damage that may apply.

name: Lava Resistant
text: Shurrak never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

name: Crag of Steel
text: When revealing a numbered order marker on Siege's Army Card, you may also reveal an "X" order marker that is on Siege's Army Card to activate Crag of Steel for the duration of the round. While Crag of Steel is active, add 3 to Siege's Defense value and subtract 2 from Siege's Attack and Move values. When Siege attacks while Crag of Steel is active, he may attack any or all adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

name: STEALTH FLYING
text: When counting spaces for Silver Surfer's movement, ignore elevations. Silver Surfer may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Silver Surfer starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: COSMIC FORCE BLAST SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 6 Attack 6
If an opponent's Unique Hero receives at least one wound from the Cosmic Force Blast Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may remove one unrevealed order marker from that Unique Hero's Army Card.

name: HYPER SPEED 5
text: After Taking a turn with Silver Surfer, Silver Surfer may move up to 5 spaces. Silver Surfer cannot use Hyper Speed 5 if he attacked with his Cosmic Force Blast Special Attack during that turn.

name: A Coward's Reward
text: Sir Denrick rolls one additional die against each figure leaving an engagement with him.

name: Giant Killer
text: When Sir Denrick attacks huge figures, add 2 attack dice.

name: Knight's Courage
text: Add 1 to Sir Dupuis' attack dice for every Knight you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Sir Dupuis up to a maximum of +3 dice.

name: TACTICAL DISENGAGEMENT 7
text: If Sir Dupuis would take 1 or more wounds from a leaving engagement attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or higher, ignore those wounds.

name: Chalice of Fortitude
text: If Sir Dupuis has 4 or more wounds on his Army Card, add 1 to his defense dice.

name: JANDAR'S DISPATCH
text: After you take a turn with Sir Gilbert you may roll 12 Jandar Valkyrie Dice. Choose up to 4 Jandar Squad figures you control that are within 8 clear sight spaces of Sir Gilbert. You may move each chosen figure a number of spaces up to the number of Jandar Symbols rolled.

name: MELEE ATTACK AURA 1
text: All friendly figures adjacent to Sir Gilbert with a Range Value of 1 add 1 to their Attack Value.

name: Blind Rage Special Attack
text: Range 1 Attack 3 If Sir Hawthorne rolls at least 2 skulls with his Blind Rage Special Attack, Sir Hawthorne may attack again with his Blind Rage Special Attack. Sir Hawthorne may continue to attack with his Blind Rage Special Attack until he rolls fewer than 2 skulls.

name: Stab in the Back
text: After you take a turn with Sir Hawthorne, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, choose an opponent. That opponent now controls Sir Hawthorne. Remove any order markers on this Army Card, then give the card to that opponent.

name: PHEROMONE COORDINATION
text: Before taking a turn with Skordyre Infantry, you may take turns with up to 2 Skordyre or Insect Common Heroes you control with different names or 1 Skordyre or Insect Unique Hero you control.

name: TEEMING
text: After a Skordyre Infantry figure you control is destroyed by a normal attack from an enemy figure, you may move 1 unengaged Common Skordyre or Insect figure you control up to 5 spaces even if all of your Skordyre Soldiers are destroyed.

name: INSECTOID SWARM
text: When a Skordyre Infantry attacks a figure engaged with at least 2 other Skordyre or Insect figures you control, add 1 to its Attack Value.

name: ASSASSINATE 2
text: Snake Eyes adds 2 to his Attack Value when attacking an enemy figure that is not adjacent to any other enemy figures.

name: EVASIVE 2
text: Snake Eyes increases his Defense Value by 2 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

name: PHANTOM WALK
text: Snake Eyes can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

name: Healing Wing 13
text: After moving nromally with Sonlen, you may choose a figure with one or more wounds that is adjacent to Sonlen or that he passed over during his movement this turn and roll a 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove one Wound Marker from that figure.

name: Dragon Assault
text: When Sonlen attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time. If Sonlen used his Flying Special Power this turn, roll 1 addtional Combat Die on the first attack.

name: DRAGON HEALING
text: At the start of Sonlen’s turn, you may choose Sonlen or a Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sonlen. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove one Wound Marker from the chosen Hero’s Army Card.

name: Dragon Swoop
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sonlen. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound.

name: Life Drain
text: Each time Sonya Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Sonya Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.

name: Eternal Strength
text: Anytime you roll the 20-sided die for Cyprien Esenwein’s Chilling Touch, you may add 2 to your die roll.

name: Eternal Heartbreak
text: If you control Cyprien Esenwein and he is destroyed, Sonya Esenwein immediately receives 2 wounds.

name: Gladiator Inspiration
text: If all Order Markers for a round are placed on Gladiator Army Cards, and at least one Order Marker is placed on Spartacus, then all Gladiators you control (except Spartacus) become inspired. Inspired Gladiators add one to their Move number and add 1 extra attack die and defense die for the rest of the round.

name: SPIDEY-SENSE 11
text: If Spider-Man is attacked by an opponent's figure and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-10, roll defense dice normally. If you roll an 11-20, Spider-Man takes no damage and may immediately move using his Swing Line 4 Special Power.

name: SWING LINE 4
text: Instead of a normal move, Spider-Man may use his Swing Line. Swing Line has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Spider-Man's Swing Line movement, ignore elevations, Spider-Man may swing over water without stopping, swing over figures without becoming engaged, and swing over obstacles such as ruins. Spider Man may not Swing-Line more than 40 levels up or down in a single Swing Line. If Spider-Man is engaged when he starts to Swing-Line, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: WEB SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 4. Attack 3.
Figures roll 1 less defense die when defending against Spider-Man's Web Special Attack.

name: CORROSIVE BILE
text: After a Spitting Hive Soldier attacks a figure or destructible object, that figure or destructible object reduces its Defense Value by 1 until the next time any player reveals an Order Marker.

name: SNEAKY SHOT 13
text: Once during your Player Turn after Storm Shadow moves 1 or more spaces and ends his movement, if he is unengaged you may choose 1 figure within 5 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the chosen figure takes 1 wound.

name: DOUBLE ASSAULT
text: Once per turn, after attacking an adjacent figure or destructible object with Storm Shadow, he may make 1 additional normal attack.

name: PHANTOM WALK
text: Storm Shadow may move though all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

name: NANITE SMOKE GRENADE
text: Start the game with 3 shadow tiles on this Army Card. At the end of Storm Shadow's turn, you may place a shadow tile from this card onto the battlefield within 3 clear sight spaces of Storm Shadow if the tile fits normally there.

name: WHIRLWIND ASSAULT
text: Storm Shadow may attack any number of times during his turn. He cannot attack any figure more than once per turn.

name: PHANTOM WALK
text: Storm Shadow can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

name: REACH
text: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of a Student of Kalari Payatt, and its level is no more than 3 levels above that Student's height or 3 levels below that Student's base, that Student may add 1 to its Range Value when attacking that figure.

name: BECOME ALL EYES
text: A Student of Kalari Payatt that is not adjacent to any figures adds 1 to its Attack and Defense Values.

name: URUMI STRIKES
text: After each Student of Kalari Payatt attacks for the first time each turn, if that Student attacked an adjacent figure, that Student may make 1 additional normal attack against a different figure.

name: Hive Supremacy
text: Anytime you roll the 20-sided die for a Marro or Wulsinu Army Card, you may add 1 to your die roll.

name: QUEEN OF THE CRYPT
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Sudema, you may take a turn with another Undead or Eisenek Hero you control that is on a shadow space or within 5 clear sight spaces. If you do not, you may instead take a turn with an Undead or Eisenek Unique Squad you control.

name: PETRIFYING GLARE 7
text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any figure within 5 clear sight spaces. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or higher, that figure takes 1 wound.

name: Stare of Stone
text: Instead of attacking, choose any figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sudema. Roll the 20-sided die. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll a 7 or higher, destroy it. If the chosen figure if a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.

name: POISON STING SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 1. Attack 4.
If Poison Sting Special Attack would inflict at least 1 wound, roll the 20-sided die for Poison Damage:
- If you roll a 10–19, add 1 to the number of wounds inflicted and roll again for Poison Damage.
- If you roll a 20, destroy the defending figure.

name: Disengage
text: Swog Rider is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: ORC ARCHER ENHANCEMENT
text: All friendly Orc Archers add 1 to their Attack and Defense Values for each adjacent Swog Rider you control.

name: VOLLEY UNTO HIMSELF
text: After moving and before attacking, you may reduce Syvarris' Range Value to 6 to make up to 2 normal attacks this turn. Or, you may reduce it to 3 to make up to 3 normal attacks this turn.

name: Double Attack
text: When Syvarris attacks, he may attack one additional time.

name: DOUBLE GUNBLADE ASSAULT
text: The first time each Player Turn Taega the Kyrie Warrior attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, add 1 to his Attack Value for that attack. Then he may make 1 additional normal attack.

name: Attack Aura
text: All figures you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Taelord get +1 to attack. Taelord's Attack Aura does not affect Taelord.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for Taelord’s movement, ignore elevations. Taelord may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Taelord starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: ONSLAUGHT AURA
text: Once per player turn, after another Gladiator figure you control or any figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Taelord the Kyrie Warrior rolls attack dice for a normal attack against an adjacent figure, it may add 1 skull to the roll.

name: DEADLY STRIKE
