text: When rolling attack dice with Taelord, each skull rolled counts for one additional skull.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Tagawa Samurai successfully defend against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: Bloodlust
text: For every opponent's figure a Tagawa Samurai destroys, place a purple Experience Marker on this card. When attacking with Tagawa Samurai, roll one additional attack die for each Experience Marker on this card. A maximum of 3 Experience Markers can be placed on this card.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: When Tagawa Samurai Archers successfully defend against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: CHOSEN OF THE BLADE
text: Takanawa Kaiga starts each game with the Bloodcursed Blade Treasure Glyph on this Army Card.

name: THE BLADE THIRSTS
text: Once per turn, after attacking a figure, you may move Kaiga up to 4 spaces and then you may make 1 normal attack. If you use The Blade Thirsts, Kaiga takes 1 wound at the end of his turn.

name: COUNTER STRIKE
text: If Kaiga successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: PLUS 2 BROADSWORD
text: If Tandros Kreel is attacking an adjacent figure, add 2 dice to Tandros Kreel's attack.

name: Cleave
text: When Tandros Kreel attacks an adjacent figure, you may choose one Squad figure that is also adjacent to Tandros Kreel. If the defending figure recieves any wounds from Tandros Kreel's attack, the chosen figure recieves one wound.

name: Combat Challenge
text: If an opponent's figure that is adjacent to Tandros Kreel attacks with a normal or special attack, it must attack Tandros Kreel.

name: Nage-Waza 9
text: Before attacking with a Tanuk Trickster, you may choose an adjacent enemy Small or Medium figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, you may move the chosen figure 1 space. Tanuki Tricksters never make leaving engagement attacks against figures moved by Nage-Waza.

name: Tanuki Aruki
text: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and tacking a turn with the Tanuk Tricksters, you may move up to 2 Small or Medium Vorid or Ninja figures you control that did not move this turn up to 3 spaces each.

name: Phantom Walk
text: Tanuki Tricksters can move through all figures and are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Berserker Charge
text: After moving and before attacking, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may move all Tarn Viking Warriors again.

name: Galloping Charge
text: A Templar Cavalry Knight receives 2 additional dice when attacking any figure that was at least 4 hexes away at the start of his turn.

name: Dismiss the Rabble
text: When rolling defense dice against adjacent small or medium Squad figures, Templar Cavalry Knights receive 1 additional defense dice.

name: Righteous Smite
text: When attacking an opponent's figure who follows Utgar; Templar Cavalry receive 1 additional attack die.

name: REJECTED BY DEATH
text: At the start of each of your turns after Thanos has been destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or higher, immediately place Thanos on a space adjacent to any figure you control and remove all Wound Markers on Thanos' card.

name: FLYING
text: When counting spaces for Thanos' movement, ignore elevations. Thanos may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Thanos starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Dwarven Strategic Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with The Axegrinders of Burning Forge, you may first take a turn with any Dwarf Hero you control. If you do not take a turn with any Dwarf Hero you control, add 2 to the Axegrinder's movement number.

name: Fearless Advantage
text: An Axegrinder of Burning Forge rolls an additional die when attacking or defending against large or huge figures.

name: Climb X2
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, The Axegrinders of Burning Forge may double their height.

name: Double Attack
text: When each member of the Einar Imperium attacks, he may attack one additional time.

name: Stealth Flying
text: When counting spaces for the Einar Imperium's movement, ignore elevations. The Einar Imperium may fly over water without stopping, pass over obstacles such as ruins. When a member of the Einar Imperium starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: EXPEDITIONARY FORCE
text: Before taking a turn with the Eisen Expedition, you may first take a turn with a Vorid or Scientist Hero you control. Add 1 to that Hero's Move Value during that turn.

name: WELL-EQUIPPED
text: Eisen Expedition figures may choose to ignore any effects from terrain tiles they move onto or occupy other than molten lava.

name: LINE UP THE SHOT 2
text: When an Eisen Expedition figure attacks a non-adjacent figure, if it did not move this turn, add 2 to its Attack Value.

name: ONE BLOW, NO TRICKS
text: The Green Knight ignores all wounds taken from special attacks or attacks from non-adjacent figures and can be targeted for an attack only once per Player Turn. After attacking with The Green Knight, none of your other figures may attack that Player Turn.

name: RETURN THE BLOW
text: After a normal attack destroys The Green Knight, at the end of your next Player Turn place The Green Knight onto an empty space adjacent to the figure that destroyed him, if possible, and take a turn with The Green Knight. During that turn, The Green Knight can attack only the figure that destroyed him. After taking that turn, destroy The Green Knight. The Green Knight is not affected by any special power on any other Army Card or Glyph while on the board for Return the Blow.

name: SUMMON THE KRAKEN
text: The Kraken does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing a numbered Order Marker on a Unique or Unfathomable Hero you control you may place 1 figure from this Squad that has not been destroyed on an empty space adjacent to that Hero.

name: COMMAND THE KRAKEN
text: Once per round, instead of taking a turn with a Unique or Unfathomable Hero you control, you may take a turn with The Kraken instead.

name: WARP SPACE
text: Instead of moving normally with 1 of The Kraken's figures, you may place that figure on an empty space within 4 spaces of that figure. If it is engaged when it starts to Warp Space, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Carry
text: Before moving Theracus, choose an unengaged friendly small or medium figure adjacent to Thercus. After you move Theracus, place the chosen figure adjacent to Theracus.

name: Defensive Aura 1
text: All friendly figures adjacent to Thorgrim add 1 die to their defense.

name: Warrior's Armor Spirit 1
text: When Thorgrim is destroyed, place this figure on any unique Army Card. Thorgrim's Spirit adds 1 to the defense number on that card.

name: RAGTAG ARMADA
text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Thormun, you may place a gold Command Marker on the Army Card of another Hero you control to immediately take a turn with that Hero. You may not place a Command Marker on the Army Card of a figure with the same Affiliation as a Hero you control that already has a Command Marker. At the end of the round, remove all of your Command Markers.

name: PIRATE KING
text: Thormun's Class is also Pirate, Captain, and King.

name: SWASHBUCKLER
text: After attacking with Thormun, you may attack an adjacent figure 1 additional time. Thormun's Attack Value is increased by 2 for the second attack.

name: GALLANT BONDING
text: Before taking a turn with Thunderhoof Cavalry, you may take a turn with a Knight or Dwarf Hero you control.

name: DWARVEN FURY
text: A Thunderhoof Cavalry figure increases its Attack Value by the number of friendly Dwarf Heroes with different names within 3 clear sight spaces.

name: KNIGHT'S VALOR
text: A Thunderhoof Cavalry figure increases its Defense Value by the number of friendly Knight Heroes with different names within 3 clear sight spaces.

name: Maddening Chitter 14
text: Once per round, before taking a turn with the Thyraxis Dragoon, you may choose an enemy figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Thyraxis and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may look at on unrevealed Order Marker on that figure's Army Card. You may then chooe any other figure controlled by the same player and move the Order Marker to that figure's Army Card.

name: Battle Frenzy 16
text: After attacking with Thyraxis Dragoon, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may attack again with Thyraxis.

name: Trample Stomp
text: At any point while moving, Tor-Kul-Na may choose a small or medium figure that is adjacent, on the same level, and on a space where Tor-Kul-Na may end his movement. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-7, the figure is safe and Tor-Kul-Na's movement ends. If you roll 8-20, the chosen figure receives one wound. If the wound destroys the figure, move Tor-Kul-Na onto the space occupied, and you may continue Tor-Kul-Na's movement. If the chosen figure is not destroyed, Tor-Kul-Na's movement ends. Tor-Kul-Na must be on a space where he can end movement each time he uses this power.

name: Battle Axe
text: If Torin is attacking a small or medium figure, add 2 dice to Torin's attack.

name: EVIL EYE PROTECTION
text: When Torin or an adjacent friendly Small or Medium Utgar figure successfully defends against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

name: Disengage
text: Tornak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: Orc Warrior Enhancement
text: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Tornak receive an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

name: Mind Blast Special Attack
text: Range 3. Attack 3. Tul-Bak-Ra does not need clear line of sight to attack with the Mind Blast Special Attack.

name: Teleportation
text: Instead of moving Tul-Bak-Ra normally, you may choose any empty space that is on the same level and within 10 spaces of Tul-Bak-Ra. Place Tul-Bak-Ra on the chosen space. When Tul-Bak-Ra starts to teleport, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Teleport Reinforcements
text: When Tul-Bak-Ra receives one or more wounds from an opposing figure's Normal or Special attack but is not destroyed, you may choose one friendly Marro Squad figure for every wound Tul-Bak-Ra just received. Place the chosen figure(s) on any empty space(s) adjacent to Tul-Bak-Ra. If the teleported figure(s) are engaged, they will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: NINJA CARRY
text: Before moving normally with a Twilight Clan Rider, you may choose a friendly Small or Medium Ninja adjacent to that Rider. After you move that Rider, you may place the chosen Ninja adjacent to that Rider. Figures may only be moved by Ninja Carry once per turn.

name: PHANTOM RIDE
text: Twilight Clan Riders can move through all figures and never take leaving engagement attacks. A Twilight Clan Rider cannot move onto a space more than 3 levels above its level.

name: TWILIGHT SLASH SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range Special. Attack 3.\nBefore attacking normally with a Twilight Clan Rider, that Rider may use Twilight Slash Special Attack. It may target any 1 figure it moved through this turn regardless of range, engagement, or line of sight. Figures never have height advantage against Twilight Slash Special Attack.

name: MIND LINK
text: After revealing an Order Marker on Ulginesh, instead of taking a turn with him, you may take a turn with up to 2 other Elf Wizards you control. Any Elf Wizard that is taking a turn instead of Ulginesh must be within 6 clear sight spaces of Ulginesh before moving.

name: BRINGER OF FLOODS
text: While Uma the Cecaelia is within 6 clear sight spaces of a Wizard you control, all land spaces within 1 of Uma, including Uma's space, that are no more than 1 level higher or lower than Uma's level are considered water spaces instead of their normal terrain type.

name: SWIM
text: Uma does not have to stop her movement when entering a water space.

name: First Assault 3
text: When attacking with Valguard, if the defending figure was not adjacent to Valguard at the start of this turn, Valguard receives 3 additional attack dice.

name: Berserker Charge Enhancement
text: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Berserker Charge power on any Army Card.

name: Slither
text: Venoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

name: Frenzy
text: After you take a turn with Venoc Vipers; roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher you may take another turn with Venoc Vipers.

name: Scout Leadership
text: All Scouts you control can move an additional 2 spaces.

name: Frenzy Enhancement
text: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Frenzy power on any Army Card.

name: Slither
text: Venoc Warlord does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces.

name: SPIDER SENSE 14
text: If Venom is attacked by an opponent's figure and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-13, roll defense normally. If you roll a 14-20, Venom takes no damage and instead may immediately move using his Swing Line 4 Special Power.

name: SWING LINE 4
text: Instead of a normal move, Venom may use his Swing Line. Swing Line has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Venom's Swing Line movement, ignore elevations. Venom may swing over water without stopping, swing over figures without becoming engaged, and swing over obstacles such as ruins. Venom may not Swing Line more than 40 levels up or down in a single Swing Line. If Venom is engaged when he starts to Swing Line, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: WEB SPECIAL ATTACK
text:
Range 4. Attack 3
Figures roll 1 less defense die when defending against Web Special Attack.

name: Glider Landing
text: Vorid Glide Strikers do not start the game on the battlefield. Before revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you may palce on Glide Striker from this card that has not been destroyed onto an empty space. You cannont place that figure adjacent to other figures. The placed figure cannot move normally this turn.

name: Evasive 1
text: Vorid Glide STrikers increase their Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

name: SHARP THORNS
text: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves onto a space adjacent to Vrono the Brambletooth where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also receives one wound.

name: Evisceraxe Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 5. The Evisceraxe Special Attack cannot be used on small figures.

name: Guard Leadership
text: All Guards you control move one additional space.

name: Tactical Switch
text: When a Warforged Soldier you control attacks an opponent's small or medium figure, you may switch that Warforged Soldier with the defending figure. After switching spaces, the Warforged Soldier must continue that attack, if possible, and cannot attack any other figure this turn. Figures moved by Tactical Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks. An opponent's figure may be moved by Tactical Switch only once per turn.

name: Warforged Resolve
text: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, a Warforged Soldier always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

name: Defensive Agility
text: When a Warrior of Ashra rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, one shield will block all damage.

name: Water Mastery
text: While a Water Elemental is on a water space, add 1 to its Attack and Defense.

name: Water Tunnel
text: If a Water Elemental ends its normal movement on a water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level water space that is within 5 spaces. If a Water Elemental is engaged when it starts its Water Tunnel, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

name: Lycanthropy
text: This Werewolf Lord starts the game with 3 green Lycanthropy Markers on its Army Card. If an opponent's Unique Hero receives at least 1 wound from this Werewolf Lord, you may place a Lycanthropy Marker on that figure's Army Card. For the duration of the game, that figure loses its Species, Class, and Personality. Instead, it has the following characteristic Species - Hybrid, Class - Hunter, Personality - Tormented. Lycanthropy never affects Constructs, Lycanthropes, Soulborgs, and Destructible Objects.

name: Moon Frenzy
text: After revealing an Order Marker on this Werewolf Lord, before taking this Werewolf Lord's turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may first take a turn with any Hybrid Hero in play. If you take a turn with an opponent's Hybrid Hero, you control that Hero for the duration of its turn. At the end of its turn, control of the Hybrid Hero returns to its previous owner. All Order Markers that were on the figure's Army Card will stay on the Army Card.

name: Fledgling Ice Shards Special Attack
text: Range 5 Attack 2 When a White Wyrmling attacks with its Fledgling Ice Shards Special Attack, it may attack 1 additional time. It cannot attack the same figure more than once this turn.

name: Wyrmling Bonding
text: After revealing an order marker on a White Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that White Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.

name: Glide In 13
text: Tuck Harrington does not start the game on the battlefield. If Harrigan has not been placed on the battlefield, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 13 or higher, place Harrigan on an empty space. You cannon place Harrigan adjacent to other figures. Then you may move any or all of your unrevealed Order Markers to this Army Card.

name: Evasive 1
text: Harrigan increases his Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

name: Coil Crush
text: When attacking a small, medium or large figure, if Wo-Sa-Ga inflicts at least 2 wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, destroy the defending figure.

name: Slither
text: Wo-Sa-Ga does not have to stop her movement when entering water spaces.

name: Darklord Bonding
text: Before taking a turn with Wolves of Badru, you may first take a turn with any Darklord you control.

name: Climb 2X
text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Wolves of Badru may double their height.

name: Pounce Special Attack
text: Range 3 Attack 5 A Wolf of Badru that moved but did not attack normally may use Pounce Special Attack. To pounce, choose a non-adjacent small or medium figure whose base is not higher or lower than 5 levels from the base of the attacking Wolf. If the figure is destroyed, immediately place the attacking Wolf on the space the figure occupied. If the figure is not destroyed, destroy the attacking Wolf.

name: Talon Grab
text: While this Wyvern is flying, you may choose one opponent's small or medium figure that it passed over this turn. Place the chosen figure on an empty same-level space adjacent to this Wyvern at the end of its move. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Talon Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Figures under overhangs can never be moved by Talon Grab.

name: Venomous Sting
text: When rolling attack dice, if this Wyvern rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure can not roll defense dice. Venomous Sting does not affect destructible objects.

name: Summon Vines
text: Xenithrax starts the game with three Xenithrax Vines Glyphs on this Army Card. Once per round, after moving and before attacking, Xenithrax may choose an empty space within 4 spaces of Xenithrax and place a Xenithrax Vines Glyph from this Army Card onto that space.

name: Erupting Earth Special Attack
text: Range 5 + Special. Attack 4 - Special.The first target of Erupting Earth Special Attack must be within a Range of 5. After attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack, you may choose a figure that was adjacent to the defending figure at the beginning of that attack and attack that chosen figure, rolling one fewer attack die. You may continue attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack in this manner, rolling one fewer attack die than the previous, up to a total of four attacks. A figure cannot be attacked more than once in a turn with Erupting Earth Special Attack.

name: AMULET OF PAIVATAR
text: When a Kyrie you control who follows Ullar within 6 clear sight spaces of Xiamara the Kyrie Warrior would receive 1 or more wounds, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8–16, ignore all but 1 wound. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore all wounds. Amulet of Paivatar does not affect Xiamara.

name: DESTRUCTIVE FORCE
text: Adjacent figures reduce their Defense Value by 1 when defending against Zartan.

name: PRIME OPPORTUNITY
text: After Zartan destroys an adjacent figure, Zartan may make an additional normal attack. Zartan may continue attacking until he does not destroy an adjacent figure.

name: CHAMELEON
text: When an enemy figure attacks with a normal attack, if it can target a figure you control without the Chameleon Special Power, it cannot target a figure you control with the Chameleon Special Power.

name: MAJESTIC FIRES SPECIAL ATTACK
text: Range 7. Attack 3. Explosion 1.\nCommon Squad figures roll 2 less defense dice against Majestic Fires Special Attack.  Zelrig cannot be affected by his own Majestic Fires Special Attack.

name: DEADLY SHOT
text: When rolling attack dice with Zetacron, each skull rolled counts for one additional skull.

name: Zettian Targeting
text: When attacking, if your second Zettian Guard attacks the same figure as the first Zettian Guard, add one attack die to the second Zettian Guard's attack.

name: Horde Movement
text: You may move up to 6. Zombies of Morindan that you control each turn. However, you may attack with only 3 Zombies of Morindan. You may attack with any 3 Zombies of Morindan, even Zombies of Morindan that you did not move this turn.

name: Zombie Onslaught Special Attack
text: Range 1. Attack 6. Three Zombies of Morindan on the same level may combine their attacks and roll their attack dice as one attack. All Zombies of Morindan in the attack must be engaged to the targeted figure.

name: Zombies Rise Again
text: If a Zombie of Morindan that you control destroys an opponent's small or medium figure, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Zombies of Morindan. Newly placed Zombies of Morindan cannot attack this turn. Undead are not affected by Zombies Rise Again.
